prs.title: feat(web-shell): explain background tasks from the composer chips
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a "?" affordance to the background-task chips above the Web Shell composer: one beside each single-task chip, and one on every row of a multi-task chip's list. Clicking it asks the model to explain what that task is doing and why it was started, and streams the answer into the existing side-question (btw) panel above the composer. The question is composed from the task snapshot the chips already read — kind, label, status, elapsed time, and per-kind facts such as the shell command and working directory, the agent prompt excerpt and recent activities, or the workflow phase, progress and log tail — with per-field excerpts and a final guard that keeps it within the daemon's 4096-character side-question limit in every shipped UI language. The instruction follows the UI language; fact labels stay English as model input.

The affordance reuses the existing btw side-question channel end to end: no new daemon route, SDK surface, or capability. The forked side-question agent shares the full conversation context, so the explanation covers why the task was launched, not just what its snapshot says, and neither the main turn nor the task itself is interrupted. The chip's own click behavior (open the task) is unchanged; hosts that do not wire the new optional callback render no "?".

## Why it's needed

The chips tell you what kind of background work is running, and clicking one opens raw detail — a shell's output, a subagent transcript, a workflow graph. Users who just want to know "what is this task actually doing?" must open and interpret those surfaces. A one-click plain-language explanation removes that step, especially while the main conversation is busy and a full prompt turn would have to wait.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session with background work (e.g. ask the agent to run a long shell command as a background task, or launch a background subagent). Above the composer, a single-task chip shows a "?" beside it; a multi-task chip shows one "?" per row when its list is open.
2. Click "?": the task does not open, no prompt turn is added to the transcript, and a 2-4 sentence explanation streams into the btw panel above the composer. The task keeps running and the list stays open.
3. Keyboard: Tab through an open list — each row stops at its open button, then its "?"; Escape on a row "?" closes the list back to its chip; the chip-adjacent "?" behaves like a chip (arrows between chips, Down/Escape/printable characters back to the composer).
4. With a very long agent prompt or label, the question still fits the daemon cap; unit tests pin the budget in EN and ZH, including surrogate-safe cuts and absent-field omission.

Commands (each runnable from the repo root):

```bash
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/utils/composerTasks.test.ts client/components/ComposerTaskChips.test.tsx
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t 'chip'
cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts web-shell.composer-task-chips --project=chromium
cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test --config playwright.visuals.config.ts composer-task-explain
```

Local results: 45/45 builder+component unit tests, 11/11 App chip-group tests, 9/9 composer-task-chips E2E (including the new "?" case), 2/2 visuals themes; i18n and visual-capture contract suites green; web-shell typecheck, ESLint and Prettier clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Dark theme, same fixture (two background agents + one background shell). Before: the base chip row and list carry no "?" (the before capture asserts the affordance count is zero on the base tree). After: the "?" beside the single-task chip, one per list row, and the streamed explanation in the btw panel.

| Before (base tree) | After (this PR) |
| --- | --- |
| ![before chips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/assets/pr17398-task-explain/pr17398/before-chips-dark.png) | ![after chips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/assets/pr17398-task-explain/pr17398/after-chips-dark.png) |
| ![before list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/assets/pr17398-task-explain/pr17398/before-list-dark.png) | ![after list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/assets/pr17398-task-explain/pr17398/after-list-dark.png) |

Live-model answer (real daemon, real background task):

![live answer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/assets/pr17398-task-explain/pr17398/after-answer-live-dark.png)

Live-model confirmation on a local daemon: a real session started real background shell tasks through real model turns; clicking "?" sent the composed question (intercepted from the request, 354 chars) and the model answered in the conversation language, naming the command, the working directory, the user's background-launch request, and an earlier task that had already finished — context beyond the snapshot — while the task kept running.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment

Node 22 per `.nvmrc`; vite dev server + headless Chromium for the E2E and visuals lanes; vitest for unit tests; the live-model run used the checkout's dev server proxied to a local `qwen serve` daemon.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each click costs one side query under the btw channel's model policy (the configured fast model, otherwise the session model) with its usual stream-retry behavior; explanations are snapshot-based, so a task launched outside the session's history is explained from its facts alone.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not tested locally; server-side aggregation of richer context (output tails, transcripts), a chip-adjacent popover, and explanation persistence are deliberately deferred in the design.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new component callback is optional. The pre-existing chip E2E spec was updated to the two-action row contract (testid locators and the open→explain Tab order) and gained a "?" side-question case; a pre-commit audit caught and fixed the locator/Tab-order breakage before submission (4 red → 9/9 green).

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-composer-task-explain/docs/design/web-shell-composer-task-explain.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-composer-task-explain/docs/design/web-shell-composer-task-explain.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

prs.title: fix(core): record snapshot cwd and refuse cross-directory file restores
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes #16982: after a resumed session moves to another directory via `/cd` (or ACP `session/cd`), rewinding to a checkpoint captured before the move expands relative tracking keys against the current working directory, silently writing the old directory's captured content into an unrelated file that happens to share the relative path in the new directory (deleting it when the first-version fallback sees "file did not exist"), while reporting success.

- `FileHistorySnapshot` and its serialized format gain an optional `cwd` recording the working directory the snapshot was captured under; payloads without the field keep their previous meaning.
- File rewind refuses at the application point: `applySnapshot` consumes tracked paths and first-version backups from the whole timeline, so any snapshot from another directory makes the whole applied set unsafe. The refusal happens before any file is touched or history is truncated; checkpoints stay in place (every rewind surface resolves turns through that array, conversation-only rewind included).
- `trackEdit` no longer folds backups captured under the current directory into a snapshot labeled with another directory; message-deletion folding (`removeFileHistorySnapshots`) no longer folds a deleted cwd-labeled snapshot's backups into a survivor that cannot prove the same root — both paths could create mixed-origin data that bypasses the guard.
- ACP `rewindToTurn` prechecks before truncating the session; conversation-only rewind stays available.
- `getDiffStats` reports nothing for a timeline holding foreign-cwd checkpoints, so previews no longer describe writes that cannot happen.
- The managed boundary carries `cwd` end to end: `ManagedToolFileHistory` copies it, the TS protocol parsers (serve/hosted CSI share the core parser) accept and validate it, and the Java-side `CsiFileHistoryProtocol` whitelist accepts the optional key with the same contract as `absolutePath` (absolute, lexically normalized, no NUL, length-bounded) — a managed CSI session's first `prepare` no longer fails.
- The design docs (en + zh-CN) now record the per-snapshot cwd decision, refusal semantics and legacy fallback.

## Why it's needed

Silent overwrite/deletion of an unrelated user file reported as success is a data-integrity defect (P1). Trigger sequence: interactive resumed session → `/cd` to another directory that has a file at the same relative path → `/rewind` to a pre-move checkpoint. The mechanism chain (`relocateWorkingDirectory` rebinds the service but keeps the old snapshots → relative keys expand against the new root) is statically confirmed in the issue and by triage; this PR implements the "honest refusal" route the issue asks for, and covers the managed boundary and the ACP truncation order flagged by triage.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

18 new tests plus shared wire fixtures. Core and managed boundary:

```bash
cd packages/core && pnpm vitest run \
  src/services/fileHistoryService.test.ts \
  src/tools/managed-tool-file-history.test.ts \
  src/tools/managed-tool-file-history-protocol.test.ts
```

Shared CSI wire fixtures (consumed by both the TS serve tests and the Java `CsiFileHistoryProtocolTest`):

```bash
cd packages/cli && pnpm vitest run \
  src/serve/managed-csi-file-history-protocol.test.ts \
  src/serve/hosted-csi-file-history.test.ts
```

ACP precheck order and the end-to-end chain:

```bash
cd packages/cli && pnpm vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts -t rewindToTurn
```

Java contract (whitelist + validation):

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest='CsiFileHistoryProtocolTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
```

Manual reproduction (issue steps): in directory A create a session, edit `file.txt` to produce a checkpoint → exit and resume → `/cd` to directory B containing a same-named `file.txt` → `/rewind` to the pre-move checkpoint. Before the fix `B/file.txt` is overwritten with A's content and reported as success; after the fix the rewind reports "checkpoints captured in a different working directory" and neither file changes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change; Before/After by tests. On the pre-fix production code, 14 of the new behavior tests fail (cross-directory refusal, cwd recording and serialization round-trip, managed transport, protocol validation, trackEdit/deletion-folding guards, ACP precheck-before-truncation, foreign-timeline diff stats), and the Java contract test fails on the shared `snapshot-cwd` fixture — a four-key snapshot rejected by the old three-key whitelist, i.e. the C1 repro from review (first managed `prepare` refused). With the fix all pass. Positive regression guards (legacy unlabeled snapshots still restore, same-directory and lexically-equivalent paths still restore, conversation-only rewind unaffected, same-root diff previews still computed) pass on both sides.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️    |

macOS locally: all suites above pass (core 135 including the managed tool/protocol suites, serve 48, Session `rewindToTurn` scope 48, Java `CsiFileHistoryProtocolTest` via Maven with a task-isolated repository); core+cli typecheck, eslint and prettier pass on the changed files. Windows/Linux not run locally: path comparisons go through `node:path` `resolve`/`normalize` on the TS side and `java.nio.file.Path` on the Java side, covered by the CI matrix; the original issue reproduction was on Windows (manual steps above).

### Environment

macOS, Node v22.23.2, corepack pnpm 11.24.0; Java: OpenJDK 25 (the repo targets Java 21), Maven 3.9.9 with a task-isolated local repository. Unit/integration tests only, no real model API calls.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: file rewind is refused wholesale for a timeline holding foreign-cwd checkpoints (including when the target itself is local, because foreign keys enter the same applied set); the user waits until the foreign checkpoints age out of the timeline via truncation, or moves the session back to the original directory. In exchange, unrelated files are never overwritten.
- Not validated / out of scope: ① legacy (pre-`cwd`) snapshots keep the old behavior in cross-directory scenarios — their capture directory is unknowable and refusing them all would make every pre-upgrade session unrestorable; tightening that (record-level cwd fallback for single legacy records, or marking a relocated timeline root-unknown while keeping conversation-only rewind) is an explicit follow-up decision for the maintainers (S1 from review). ② No manual Windows reproduction. ③ Full-repo `npm run preflight` and the full Managed Agent Java/native suites not run locally; CI gates cover them.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `cwd` is optional and old payloads are unaffected; accepting `cwd` in the managed CSI contracts is additive on both sides.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16982

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

修复 #16982：已 resume 的会话经 `/cd`（或 ACP `session/cd`）移动到另一目录后，`/rewind` 恢复移动前创建的检查点时，相对跟踪键按当前工作目录展开，会把旧目录捕获的内容写进新目录下恰好同相对路径的无关文件（首版回退判定"文件当时不存在"时甚至直接删除该文件），且结果报告成功无失败。

- `FileHistorySnapshot` 及其序列化格式新增可选 `cwd` 字段，记录快照产生时的工作目录；旧载荷不含该字段，行为不变。
- 文件回退在应用点整体拒绝：`applySnapshot` 消费时间线全部 tracked 路径与首版备份，任一快照来自其他目录即不安全。命中即报错退出，不动任何文件、不截断历史；检查点保留在时间线原位（各 rewind 表面按位置解析回合，conversation-only 回退也依赖该数组，不受影响）。
- `trackEdit` 不把当前目录捕获的备份折进标签为其他目录的快照；消息删除折叠（`removeFileHistorySnapshots`）不把带 `cwd` 标签的被删快照备份折进无法证明同根的幸存快照——这两条路径都会制造混合来源数据绕过守卫。
- ACP `rewindToTurn` 在截断会话历史之前预检，跨目录时间线直接拒绝；conversation-only 回退不受影响。
- 外来时间线的 `getDiffStats` 不再给出统计，预览不再描述不可能发生的写入。
- 托管边界端到端携带 `cwd`：`ManagedToolFileHistory` 复制、TS 协议解析（serve/hosted CSI 共用 core 解析器）接受并校验，Java 侧 `CsiFileHistoryProtocol` 白名单接受该可选键并按 `absolutePath` 同一契约校验（绝对、逐词法规范化、无 NUL、限长）——托管 CSI 会话的首次 `prepare` 不再被拒。
- 设计文档中英两版同步记录 per-snapshot `cwd` 的决策、拒绝语义与 legacy 兜底。

## 为什么需要

静默覆写/删除无关用户文件且报告成功，属于数据完整性缺陷（P1）。触发序列：交互模式 resume 会话 → `/cd` 到另一目录（该目录存在同相对路径文件）→ `/rewind` 到移动前的检查点。机制链（`relocateWorkingDirectory` 重绑服务但保留旧快照 → 相对键按新根展开）issue 与 triage 均已静态确认；本 PR 按 issue 认可的"诚实拒绝"路线实现，另覆盖 triage 指出的托管边界与 ACP 截断时序。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

新增 18 个测试与共享 wire fixtures。核心与托管边界：

```bash
cd packages/core && pnpm vitest run \
  src/services/fileHistoryService.test.ts \
  src/tools/managed-tool-file-history.test.ts \
  src/tools/managed-tool-file-history-protocol.test.ts
```

共享 CSI wire fixtures（TS serve 测试与 Java `CsiFileHistoryProtocolTest` 共同消费）：

```bash
cd packages/cli && pnpm vitest run \
  src/serve/managed-csi-file-history-protocol.test.ts \
  src/serve/hosted-csi-file-history.test.ts
```

ACP 预检时序与端到端链路：

```bash
cd packages/cli && pnpm vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts -t rewindToTurn
```

Java 契约（白名单 + 校验）：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest='CsiFileHistoryProtocolTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
```

手工复现（issue 步骤）：目录 A 建会话编辑 `file.txt` 产生检查点 → 退出后 resume → `/cd` 到含同名 `file.txt` 的目录 B → `/rewind` 选移动前检查点。修复前 `B/file.txt` 被 A 的内容覆写且报告成功；修复后明确报错 "checkpoints captured in a different working directory"，两目录文件均未改动。

### 证据（前后对比）

非 UI 改动，Before/After 以测试为准：在未打本修复的生产代码上，14 个新行为用例失败（跨目录拒绝、cwd 记录与序列化往返、托管传输、协议校验、trackEdit/删除折叠守卫、ACP 截断前预检、外来时间线 diff 统计），且 Java 契约测试在共享 `snapshot-cwd` fixture 上失败——四键快照被旧的三键白名单拒绝，即评审中的 C1 复现（托管首次 `prepare` 被拒）。打上修复后全部通过；正例回归保护用例（legacy 无标签快照照常恢复、同目录与词法等价路径照常恢复、conversation-only 回退不受影响、同根 diff 预览照常计算）在两侧均通过。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️    |

macOS 本地：上述全部套件通过（core 135 例含托管 tool/protocol 套件、serve 48 例、Session `rewindToTurn` 域 48 例、Java `CsiFileHistoryProtocolTest` 经 Maven 隔离仓库运行）；core+cli typecheck、eslint、prettier 通过。Windows/Linux 未本地执行：TS 侧路径比较统一走 `node:path` 的 `resolve`/`normalize`、Java 侧走 `java.nio.file.Path`，由 CI 矩阵覆盖；issue 原始复现基于 Windows（手工步骤见上）。

### 环境

macOS，Node v22.23.2，corepack pnpm 11.24.0；Java：OpenJDK 25（仓库目标 Java 21）、Maven 3.9.9 任务隔离本地仓库。仅单元/集成测试，未调用真实模型 API。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：跨目录时间线内文件回退被整体拒绝（包括目标本身是本地检查点的情形，因为外来键同样进入应用集合），需要等外来检查点随历史截断移出时间线，或把会话移回原目录后再恢复；换来的是绝不覆写无关文件。
- 未验证/范围外：① legacy（无 `cwd` 字段）快照在跨目录场景保持旧行为——无法得知其捕获目录，全量拒绝会使所有升级前会话不可恢复；收紧方案（对单条 legacy 记录使用记录级 cwd 兜底，或 relocation 后把时间线标为 root-unknown、拒绝文件恢复但保留 conversation-only 回退）是显式留给维护者的后续决策（评审 S1）。② Windows 真机手工复现未执行。③ 全仓 `npm run preflight` 与 Managed Agent Java/native 全量套件未本地跑，由 CI 门覆盖。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。`cwd` 为可选字段，旧载荷读写不受影响；托管 CSI 契约对 `cwd` 的接受在两侧均为增量。

</details>

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): distinguish missing logs from missing test results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Failure summaries now show how many downloaded log files were analyzed compared with the number of jobs reported as failed. For example, a run with two failed jobs and one supplied log reports `1 of 2 failed-job logs (incomplete coverage)`, while retaining the available job, step and test details.

The update follows the current reporting flow shared by tracking issues and PR comments. It preserves workflow-based issue aggregation and the existing statement that no test identifier was available when no failure can be recognized.

## Why it's needed

Missing or empty log downloads can hide useful failure evidence. The report should show that limitation without treating missing evidence as proof that tests did not run. Equal input and failed-job counts do not certify complete log contents or a complete list of failing tests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With one failed job and no supplied logs, expect `0 of 1` and an incomplete-coverage notice. A supplied zero-byte log counts as one input. With two failed jobs and one log containing a recognizable failing test, expect `1 of 2` while keeping the test, job details and run link. More supplied logs than recorded failed jobs also produce a mismatch notice.

When the job list is empty or unavailable, expect that uncertainty to remain explicit. Successful, cancelled and timed-out jobs are excluded from the failed-job count. A summary without an identified test continues to direct readers to the run logs and annotations.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no CLI/TUI change. The local reporting-command regressions below cover the generated issue and PR summary text.

- Six real `analyze → comment` CLI regressions: 6 failed on the unmodified upstream helper, 6 passed with this change. Each case uses temporary files and real Node subprocesses; no mocks were added.
- Complete helper suite on Windows: 60 passed, 4 skipped, 4 failed. An independent run of the unmodified upstream helper reproduced the same four Flyway path-encoding failures.
- Reporting workflow suite: 33 passed, 43 failed. The unmodified upstream helper and tests reproduce the exact same 43 failing test names; failures involve Windows/Bash paths, environment variables and unavailable `jq`.
- Scoped ESLint, Prettier and whitespace checks passed.
- The frozen dependency install completed its normal prepare lifecycle, including the full build and bundle (exit 0). Existing native-audio, bundle-size and Node deprecation warnings remain visible in the log.
- The complete typecheck, including every workspace and integration tests, passed after the build (exit 0). The full preflight is not claimed green because the helper and workflow suites retain the baseline failures disclosed above.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Tested |
| Linux | Not tested |

### Environment

Node.js 24.15.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Local Node subprocesses and temporary files; no live failure report was published.

## Risk & Scope

- The count describes input files rather than their content completeness.
- Hosted CI and Linux/macOS execution remain unverified locally.
- The change retains the upstream workflow, issue aggregation and report destinations; no configuration or data migration is required.

## AI assistance

Codex assisted with the implementation, real-process regression tests, documentation and validation. Independent Codex verification checked the actual workflow call path and upstream test baselines.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the log-availability finding in #11115.

- 数量描述输入文件，不代表日志内容完整。
- GitHub CI 和 Linux/macOS 执行尚未在本地验证。
- 保留上游工作流、issue 汇总及报告目标，不需要配置或数据迁移。

## AI 协助

Codex 协助实现、真实进程回归、文档和验证。独立 Codex 验证核对了实际工作流调用和上游测试基线。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add delivery-unit change overview for sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a **Change overview** tab to the Web Shell right panel that rolls up the session's changed files and their `+/-` scale, segmented the way work is delivered rather than by conversation turn. A scope selector switches between the **uncommitted** batch, **one scope per bound pull request**, and a **commit fallback** for commits that no bound PR covers yet. Each scope shows a file list with per-file additions/deletions and a total scale header; PR scopes link out to the PR.

Session attribution reuses what the daemon already reports on the session summary (bound `prs`, `branch`, `worktree`), so a worktree-isolated session is naturally session-scoped. To support the per-PR scopes this also adds a read-only daemon route that returns one PR's changed-file list and scale via the `gh` CLI, plus the matching core helper and SDK method.

## Why it's needed

As a session runs, the agent edits many files and it becomes hard to tell how large the accumulated change has grown. The existing surfaces don't answer that: the per-turn cards and review tab are tool-call based and turn-scoped (committed work keeps counting, and there is no whole-session roll-up), while the Git dialog shows workspace state without segmenting by delivery unit. Reviewers and operators want to see "what is still uncommitted" and "what went into each PR" at a glance, with the file list and the scale together.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a Web Shell session in a git workspace that has uncommitted edits and at least one bound PR (create a PR from the Git dialog, or use a session that already has one).
2. Open the right panel, click **+ → Change overview**.
3. Confirm the scope selector lists **Uncommitted**, one entry per bound PR (`#number`), and commit-fallback entries; selecting each renders that unit's file list and `+/-` totals, and the PR scope shows an "Open PR" link.
4. Degradation: in a non-git workspace the panel shows a "not a git repository" message; with `gh` missing or an older daemon the PR scope still appears but shows "file list unavailable" instead of blanking.

Focused tests (run from the repo root; web-shell needs Node 22/24):

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/github-prs.test.ts`
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-github-prs.test.ts`
- `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts -t "fetches a PR file list"`
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/change-overview.test.ts client/components/artifacts/useChangeOverview.test.tsx client/components/artifacts/ChangeOverviewPanel.test.tsx`

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no delivery-unit roll-up existed — only turn-scoped cards and the workspace Git dialog. After: the Change overview tab (real Web Shell renders captured through the visuals E2E harness; the daemon HTTP is mocked, not a live end-to-end run):

| Uncommitted scope (dark) | Bound-PR scope (dark) |
| :--: | :--: |
| ![Change overview — uncommitted scope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-change-overview/change-overview-uncommitted-dark.png) | ![Change overview — PR scope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-change-overview/change-overview-pr-dark.png) |

Light theme, PR scope:

![Change overview — PR scope, light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-change-overview/change-overview-pr-light.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux (Node v24.22.1). Unit/component tests via vitest; UI captures via the web-shell visuals Playwright harness (Chromium headless shell) against a mock daemon. `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` build + `tsc --noEmit` typecheck green on the rebased branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the per-PR file list shells out to `gh pr view`, so it needs `gh` installed/authenticated; it is capped, redacted and timeout-guarded like the sibling PR helpers, and degrades to "file list unavailable" otherwise. The commit fallback fetches up to 20 commit details, bounded.
- Not validated / out of scope: real-browser E2E against a live daemon and a real-git smoke of the new route are left as follow-ups; macOS/Windows not exercised. Per-line diffs stay in the Git dialog / review tab — the overview is a file-list + scale roll-up only.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Read-only; the files route is advertised under the existing `workspace_github_prs` capability tag (no new tag). A daemon that advertises the tag but predates the files route answers 404, which the overview treats as "unavailable"; a daemon that predates the tag itself shows no PR scopes at all, since the hook gates PR fetching on the capability.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-16-web-shell-change-overview.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-web-shell-change-overview.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 右侧面板新增**变更总览**页，把会话的变更文件与其 `+/-` 规模汇总起来，并按交付方式（而非对话轮次）分段。范围选择器可在**未提交**批次、**每个绑定 PR 一个范围**、以及尚未进入任何绑定 PR 的 **commit 兜底**之间切换。每个范围展示带每文件增删行数的文件列表与总规模头部；PR 范围附跳转链接。

会话归属复用 daemon 已在会话摘要里上报的信息（绑定的 `prs`、`branch`、`worktree`），因此 worktree 隔离的会话天然按会话隔离。为支持按 PR 的范围，还新增了一个只读 daemon 路由，通过 `gh` CLI 返回某个 PR 的变更文件列表与规模，以及配套的 core 助手与 SDK 方法。

## 为什么需要

会话进行中，agent 会编辑大量文件，越来越难判断累计改动有多大。现有界面回答不了：每轮卡片与审阅页基于工具调用、按轮划分（已提交的仍被计入，也没有全会话汇总）；Git 对话框展示工作区状态但不按交付单元分段。评审者与使用者希望一眼看到「还有哪些未提交」「每个 PR 各进了什么」，并把文件列表与规模放在一起。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在一个有未提交编辑、且至少绑定了一个 PR 的 git 工作区里打开 Web Shell 会话（从 Git 对话框创建 PR，或用已有绑定 PR 的会话）。
2. 打开右侧面板，点 **+ → 变更总览**。
3. 确认范围选择器列出**未提交**、每个绑定 PR 一项（`#number`）、以及 commit 兜底项；选中各项渲染该单元的文件列表与 `+/-` 总数，PR 范围显示「打开 PR」链接。
4. 降级：非 git 工作区面板显示「不是 git 仓库」；缺 `gh` 或旧 daemon 时 PR 范围仍显示，但呈现「文件列表不可用」而非空白。

聚焦测试（在仓库根运行；web-shell 需 Node 22/24）：

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/github-prs.test.ts`
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/workspace-github-prs.test.ts`
- `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts -t "fetches a PR file list"`
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/artifacts/change-overview.test.ts client/components/artifacts/useChangeOverview.test.tsx client/components/artifacts/ChangeOverviewPanel.test.tsx`

### 证据（前后对照）

改动前：没有按交付单元的汇总，只有按轮的卡片与工作区 Git 对话框。改动后：变更总览页（通过 visuals E2E harness 捕获的真实 Web Shell 渲染；daemon HTTP 为 mock，非 live 端到端）：

| 未提交范围（暗色） | 绑定 PR 范围（暗色） |
| :--: | :--: |
| ![变更总览——未提交范围](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-change-overview/change-overview-uncommitted-dark.png) | ![变更总览——PR 范围](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-change-overview/change-overview-pr-dark.png) |

亮色主题，PR 范围：

![变更总览——PR 范围，亮色](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-change-overview/change-overview-pr-light.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ 已测试   |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux（Node v24.22.1）。单测/组件测试用 vitest；界面截图用 web-shell visuals Playwright harness（Chromium headless shell）对 mock daemon 捕获。rebase 后的分支上 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 构建 + `tsc --noEmit` 类型检查均绿。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：按 PR 的文件列表会调用 `gh pr view`，需要已安装并登录 `gh`；与兄弟 PR 助手一样设上限、脱敏、超时守卫，否则降级为「文件列表不可用」。commit 兜底最多拉取 20 个 commit 详情，有界。
- 未验证/范围外：对 live daemon 的真实浏览器 E2E 与新路由的真 git 冒烟留作后续；未测 macOS/Windows。逐行 diff 仍由 Git 对话框/审阅页承担——总览只做文件列表 + 规模汇总。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。只读；files 路由挂在现有 `workspace_github_prs` capability 标签下（不新增 tag）。已声明该标签但早于 files 路由的 daemon 返回 404，总览按「不可用」处理；早于该标签本身的 daemon 则完全不显示 PR 范围（hook 以该 capability 作为 PR 拉取门槛）。

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-11-16-web-shell-change-overview.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-16-web-shell-change-overview.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): Complete the Russian Web Shell UI catalog
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ships a complete Russian UI catalog for Web Shell and Qwen Code Desktop, matching the existing `Русский [ru]` picker entry. Chrome that previously fell back to English (new session, workspaces, recent, welcome prompt, settings, live, collab, managed surfaces, and the other split dictionaries) now renders in Russian when `general.language` is `ru`.

The extra catalog is stubbed out of the read-only transcript / HTML export bundle so every exported file does not download a third full UI dictionary.

## Why it's needed

The language picker already advertised Russian, but the `ru` table was a stub of about 75 Goal-dialog keys against ~4000 English strings, so menus stayed English. CLI `lib/locales/ru.js` was already complete. Setting precedence and live switch from the same report already land on main; this change is the missing catalog.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell or Desktop with `general.language` set to `ru` (Settings → General → Language: UI → `Русский [ru]`, or `"general.language": "ru"` in settings).
2. Confirm chrome is Russian: new session, workspaces, recent, welcome prompt, settings panel, activity, and error/auth gates.
3. Switch back to English / Chinese and confirm those catalogs are unchanged.
4. Optional: `/export html` still builds; the document-export renderer stays under the existing byte budget because the Russian interactive catalog is stubbed in `--mode transcript`.

Unit pins: `packages/web-shell/client/i18n.test.ts` (chrome, plurals, quota, transcript stubs), split-module RU key parity, and `build-artifact.test.ts` (distinctive Russian strings in the interactive bundle only).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — catalog and docs; chrome strings are pinned in unit tests rather than a TUI recording.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ (unit tests, web-shell typecheck, web-shell + web-templates build) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Worktree unit tests and package builds (`packages/web-shell`, `packages/web-templates`). Node v26 locally; CI is Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Russian copy is a full human-language catalog, so wording can be improved later; exported HTML transcripts fall back to English for those UI strings to keep the document-export budget.
- Not validated / out of scope: slash-command completion trees stay English/Chinese; AssistantMessage translate remains zh-CN-only; no e2e locale matrix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `ru` was already a shipped picker value.

## Linked Issues

Closes #17382

prs.title: docs(design): record the landings the channel design statuses still hide
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Records the landings that six design statuses in the bound-delivery series still hide. Documentation only, twelve files, both languages, +12/−12.

| Design | Status before | Landing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bound-pr-comment-watch` | `proposed` | #16602 created the file and shipped the watch in the same commit; #17199 later added the downtime-backlog digest |
| `bound-session-action-templates` | `implemented on feat/… (pending review)` | #16258, merged 2026-11-04 |
| `bound-delivery-startup-backlog` | `proposed` | #17199 created the file and shipped the digest in the same commit |
| `github-channel-conditional-requests` | `proposed` | #16741 created the file and shipped conditional polling in the same commit |
| `github-channel-budget-awareness` | `- Status: proposed` (bullet form; zh said 提议中) | #16701 created the file and shipped the hook, reserve gate and journaling in the same commit |
| `github-channel-bound-session-events` (base) | called the templates design "proposed" | templates shipped as #16258 |

Each status now names its landing PR and keeps the body as the as-designed record — the convention the sibling designs already use. The conditional-requests entry keeps its `Implements #16691` link and its recorded baseline. Four of the five were stale from birth: the implementing PR created the design file in the same commit and never came back to the status line. The budget-awareness entry also records that PR B (#17214) removed the channel's PR-state detection, so its budget gate now protects the comment-watch pass — the status does not imply the designed pass still exists.

**The series now has no design left reading `proposed`.**

## Why it's needed

A status line is what a contributor reads to decide whether a design is a plan or a record. Four shipped features reading as proposals invite re-implementation, and the base design calling an implemented design "proposed" propagates that misreading to everyone who starts from the base.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

For each row, check the landing commit rather than the prose:

- `git show <merge> --name-only` contains the design file, and the feature's code is on `main` (`prCommentWatch`, `boundSessionActions`, conditional-request handling in `GithubAdapter.ts`).
- The status lines name those PRs in both languages, and the bodies carry the as-designed framing.

### Evidence

Docs-only, so no runtime A/B. The load-bearing evidence is a claim ledger checked against the repository and `gh`, with positive controls: **20/20 cells**.

- C1–C8: each landing PR merged and its commit contains the design file; the conditional-request and budget mechanisms are live on `main`; the budget-gated pass now carries the comment watch.
- C6–C11: each status records the right PR in both languages; the base design no longer calls templates proposed; all four edited designs keep the as-designed framing; the `#16691` link and baseline survive.
- P1–P5 (controls): no `proposed` status remains in the series under any of the three status formats (top-level, bullet, and the zh 提案/提议中 variants); `pending review` / 待评审 is gone; the stale branch name is gone; the comment-watch's historical revision paragraph is preserved.

One ledger cell failed on the first run and the cause was the probe, not the claim: `git show --stat` elides long filenames (`…26-11-09-github-channel-conditional-requests.md`), so a full-name `includes` check was a false negative. Switching to `--name-only` made it pass; the underlying facts were verified separately.

**Not changed, deliberately:** the `requireBoundWatch` scope gap recorded in an earlier review was re-derived against `watchGateExcludes` (`requireBoundWatch && (role === 'review' || role === 'verify') && watching === false`). The table row, the scoped-delivery paragraph and the gate paragraph all match it, including fail-open on unknown watching. The gap is not present, so no edit was invented for it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍎 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

## Risk & Scope

- Documentation only; no code, no behaviour change.
- Bodies, historical revision paragraphs and recorded baselines are untouched; only status lines and one cross-reference change.
- Designs outside this series still read `proposed`; they are out of scope here.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #17395, which closed the master design's owed claims. Records #16602, #16258, #17199 and #16741 as the landings their designs never named.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

记录绑定投递系列里六处设计状态仍在隐瞒的落地。纯文档，十二个文件，双语，+12/−12。

| 设计 | 原状态 | 落地 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bound-pr-comment-watch` | `proposed` | #16602 在同一提交里创建该文件并落地 watch；#17199 后续加入停机积压摘要 |
| `bound-session-action-templates` | `implemented on feat/…（待评审）` | #16258，2026-11-04 合入 |
| `bound-delivery-startup-backlog` | `proposed` | #17199 在同一提交里创建该文件并落地摘要 |
| `github-channel-conditional-requests` | `proposed` | #16741 在同一提交里创建该文件并落地条件请求轮询 |
| `github-channel-budget-awareness` | `- Status: proposed`（列表项形式；zh 写「提议中」） | #16701 在同一提交里创建该文件并落地钩子、预留门与日志 |
| `github-channel-bound-session-events`（基础） | 称 templates 设计为「提案中」 | templates 已以 #16258 落地 |

每处状态现在点名其落地 PR，正文保持「按当时设计」的记录——即兄弟设计已在用的约定。conditional-requests 条目保留其 `实现 #16691` 链接与记录的基线。其中四处自诞生即陈旧：实现 PR 在同一提交里创建设计文件，却从未回头改状态行。budget-awareness 条目还记录了 PR B（#17214）移除了 channel 的 PR 状态检测，因此其预算门现在保护的是评论监视 pass——状态行不暗示原设计的 pass 仍存在。

**本系列现已无任何设计仍读作 `proposed`。**

## 为什么需要

状态行是贡献者用来判断一份设计是计划还是记录的依据。四个已落地功能读作提案会招来重复实现；基础设计把已实现的设计称为「提案中」，则会把这一误读传播给每个从基础设计入手的人。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

逐行核对落地提交而非散文：`git show <merge> --name-only` 含该设计文件，且功能代码在 `main` 上（`prCommentWatch`、`boundSessionActions`、`GithubAdapter.ts` 的条件请求处理）；状态行双语点名这些 PR，正文带「按当时设计」限定。

### 证据

纯文档，无运行时 A/B。承重证据是对着仓库与 `gh` 核对的 claim ledger，带正向控制：**20/20 格**。C1–C8 核每个落地 PR 已合入且其提交含该设计文件、条件请求与预算机制在 main 上、预算门控的 pass 现承载评论监视；C6–C11 核双语状态、基础设计交叉引用、四处正文限定、`#16691` 链接与基线存活；P1–P5 为控制（三种状态格式下系列均无 proposed 残留、待评审已去、陈旧分支名已去、历史修订段保留）。

首轮有一格失败，原因在探针不在声明：`git show --stat` 会省略长文件名，导致全名 `includes` 假阴性；改用 `--name-only` 后通过，底层事实另行单独核实过。

**刻意未改**：早前评审记录的 `requireBoundWatch` 作用域缺口，已按 `watchGateExcludes` 重新推导——表格行、限定投递段与门控段均与谓词一致（含 unknown 时 fail-open）。缺口不存在，故未为它虚构改动。

### 测试平台

🐧 Linux ✅；macOS / Windows N/A。

## 风险与范围

纯文档，无代码、无行为变更。正文、历史修订段与记录基线均未触碰，只改状态行与一处交叉引用。本系列之外的设计仍读作 `proposed`，不在本次范围。

## 关联 Issue

#17395 的后续（它关掉了母设计的欠项声明）。记录 #16602、#16258、#17199、#16741 为其设计从未点名的落地。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): align serverRevision ceiling across contract, management and persistence
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`serverRevision` had three different ceilings. The OpenAPI contract and the `ManagedMcpManagementService.requireSnapshot` counter accepted 2^53-1, while the extension-record `count()` rule clamped a wider max down to 2^53-2. A revision of exactly 2^53-1 therefore passed admission and was refused later, and the refusal printed the caller's unclamped max — one higher than the bound actually enforced. This PR moves the contract, the management read path, the CLI pins and the persistence admission shape onto the single shared ceiling, and makes the refusal message report the bound it enforces.

## Why it's needed

The record contract fixes counts at 2^53-2 (`docs/design/2026-09-27-managed-extension-record-contract.md`), and the TypeScript `assertManagedSessionSequence` rejects `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` outright. The public contract was the outlier: it advertised a ceiling the persistence layer never accepted. After this change a snapshot the harness may legally return is also one the published contract permits, so the service can no longer relay a response its own contract calls invalid.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-mcp-record.test.ts` — the shared fixtures are read by both the TypeScript and the Java reader, so a passing run confirms the two agree on the boundary.
- The `unsafe-server-revision` fixture now patches `run.definition.definitionRevision` alongside `serverRevision`. With only `serverRevision` patched, the pin-equality rule in `pinnedRun` refused the record on its own, so the case passed even with the ceiling guard removed; with both patched it fails only if the `MAX_SAFE_COUNTER` guard is what refuses it. `max-server-revision` is the positive counterpart at 2^53-2.
- `ManagedMcpRecordContractTest#boundsEveryPublicMcpSequenceAtTheSharedCeiling` mirrors that pair against the Java record and asserts the refusal names the enforced ceiling.
- `node scripts/check-contract-version.js <base> <head>` — the document changes six `maximum` values, so `info.version` advances to 1.112.0 past main's 1.111.0.

Expected: the whole boundary sits at 2^53-2 on every layer, and a 2^53-1 value is refused with a message that states 9007199254740990.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — contract and validation change, no user-visible surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, vitest from the worktree's `node_modules`. Java was not built — see Risk & Scope.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: historical data can exist. The persisted managed-record layer has always clamped at 2^53-2 (`ManagedExtensionRecords.MAX_COUNT`), but the management-command path admitted 2^53-1 on both sides before this change — `ApiModels.ManagedMcpServerPin` declared `@Max(9_007_199_254_740_991L)` and `parseHostedMcpServers` only required `Number.isSafeInteger`, so a Session created earlier can hold a `…991` selection. Such a Session now fails `requireSnapshot` and its management read path returns `managed_mcp_management_unavailable` (503), consistent with the existing `Invalid MCP management snapshot` failure mode. The same spread reaches the persistence read path too: `readHostedMcpSettings` (`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-mcp-settings.ts:189`, which calls `parseHostedMcpServers` at :244) throws `Invalid MCP settings.` for an existing `…991` pin. That behaviour was not traced further into Session open, so its blast radius there is unverified. I took the convergence rather than rolling back the response maxima, because a rollback leaves the contract advertising a bound the persistence layer refuses.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java module was not compiled or tested on this machine — it has no JDK or Maven (`/usr/bin/java` is a stub), so `ManagedMcpRecordContractTest`, `ManagedAgentApiContractTest`, `ManagedMcpManagementServiceTest` and checkstyle are left to CI. `ManagedDiagnosticMcpServer.serverRevision`, `ManagedToolMeasurements.MAX_COUNT` and the client-side `Number.isSafeInteger` guards stay where they are; they are consistent with their own code and only ever wider, so they are not a regression of this change. The repository-wide `npm run build` also fails in `packages/channels/github` on this checkout for an unrelated missing cross-package type.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for well-formed data; the only observable change is the rejection described above.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16886

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`serverRevision` 此前有三个不同的上限。OpenAPI 契约和 `ManagedMcpManagementService.requireSnapshot` 的计数器接受 2^53-1，而扩展记录的 `count()` 规则会把更宽的 max 夹到 2^53-2。于是恰好等于 2^53-1 的 revision 能通过准入、之后才被拒，而且拒绝信息打印的是调用方传入的、未夹紧的 max —— 比真正生效的上界高 1。本 PR 把契约、management 读路径、CLI pin 和持久化准入形状统一到同一个共享上限，并让拒绝信息播报它真正执行的界限。

## 为什么需要

记录契约把计数定在 2^53-2（`docs/design/2026-09-27-managed-extension-record-contract.md`），TypeScript 的 `assertManagedSessionSequence` 也直接拒绝 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`。公开契约才是那个例外：它宣传了一个持久化层从不接受的上限。改动之后，harness 可以合法返回的快照，也是已发布契约允许的值，服务端不会再转发被自家契约判为非法的响应。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

- `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-mcp-record.test.ts`。共享夹具由 TypeScript 与 Java 两个读取器共用，通过即说明两者在边界上一致。
- `unsafe-server-revision` 夹具现在同时 patch `run.definition.definitionRevision` 与 `serverRevision`。此前只 patch `serverRevision` 时，`pinnedRun` 的 pin 相等规则自己就会拒绝它，所以即使移除上界守卫该用例仍然通过；两者都 patch 后，只有 `MAX_SAFE_COUNTER` 守卫才是拒绝的原因。`max-server-revision` 是 2^53-2 的正向对照。
- `ManagedMcpRecordContractTest#boundsEveryPublicMcpSequenceAtTheSharedCeiling` 在 Java 记录上镜像这对用例，并断言拒绝信息里写明真正执行的上界。
- `node scripts/check-contract-version.js <base> <head>`：文档改了六处 `maximum`，因此 `info.version` 推进到 1.112.0，越过 main 的 1.111.0。

预期：边界在每一层都是 2^53-2，2^53-1 被拒且信息中写明 9007199254740990。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 契约与校验改动，没有用户可见界面。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

Node 24，vitest 来自 worktree 的 `node_modules`。Java 未构建 —— 见「风险与范围」。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：已存储且带 `serverRevision = 2^53-1` 的记录会使 `requireSnapshot` 失败，对该 Session 表现为 `managed_mcp_management_unavailable`（503）。写入路径一直是按 2^53-2 夹紧的（`ManagedExtensionRecords.MAX_COUNT`），所以健康系统不可能产生这种记录；若确有历史脏数据，该 503 与既有的 `Invalid MCP management snapshot` 失败模式一致。我选择收敛而不是回退四处响应上限，因为回退会让契约继续宣传一个持久化层拒绝的限制。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：本机没有编译或测试 Java 模块 —— 没有 JDK 和 Maven（`/usr/bin/java` 是 stub），所以 `ManagedMcpRecordContractTest`、`ManagedAgentApiContractTest`、`ManagedMcpManagementServiceTest` 与 checkstyle 留给 CI。`ManagedDiagnosticMcpServer.serverRevision`、`ManagedToolMeasurements.MAX_COUNT` 以及客户端侧的 `Number.isSafeInteger` 守卫保持原样；它们与自身代码一致且只会更宽，不构成本次改动的回归。仓库级 `npm run build` 在这个 checkout 上也会因 `packages/channels/github` 缺跨包类型而失败，与本改动无关。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对格式正确的数据没有；唯一可观察的变化是上面描述的拒绝。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16886

</details>

prs.title: fix(config): declare model.chatCompression knobs and allow disabling image payload eviction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes image-payload eviction switchable off, and declares the `model.chatCompression` settings that the runtime already reads.

The eviction threshold now accepts `0`, which means "never rewrite image payloads out of history". The eviction pass is skipped entirely in that case, so the stored history keeps every inline image and so does the outgoing request on an image-capable route. A route whose model declares no image support is still slimmed to `[image: ...]` placeholders before the request is sent.

Declaring these knobs as `integer` also makes them settable through `/config`: `integer` was missing from `SETTABLE_TYPES`, so `/config` now lists 272 rows instead of 248 — the six knobs here plus 18 pre-existing integer settings that were settable but invisible.

`model.chatCompression` was declared in the settings schema as a bare object with no properties, so `imagePayloadThreshold`, `imageTokenEstimate`, `maxRecentFilesToRetain`, `maxRecentImagesToRetain`, `enableScreenshotTrigger` and `screenshotTriggerThreshold` were invisible to settings help, validation and the IDE schema. They are now declared with the defaults and bounds the runtime resolvers already enforce, and the generated IDE JSON schema is regenerated from them. The settings reference documents the eviction threshold and the image token estimate, which were previously undocumented.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #15495. A vision workflow that needs every frame in history had no supported way to stop eviction: the threshold accepted only integers >= 1, and setting a very large number was an undocumented workaround. Undeclared settings also meant the knobs never surfaced in help or validation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npm -w packages/core run build`
2. `npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` — 761 tests pass, including two new ones: the resolver accepts `0`, and a session with three inline images keeps all three in both the durable history and the later request when the threshold is `0`.
3. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/config/` — 2167 tests pass, including a new assertion that every `model.chatCompression` knob is declared with its runtime bound.
4. `npx prettier --check` and `eslint --max-warnings 0` on the touched files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change (config + schema + docs), so N/A. The new `llm-chat` test fails when the `imagePayloadThreshold > 0` guard is removed, which is the regression this pins.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run build` for `packages/core` plus vitest unit runs; no sandbox or live model endpoint involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `0` is a new accepted value for a knob whose previous minimum was `1`. A user who set `0` before got the default `20` silently; they now get eviction disabled. That reading matches every other "count of items to keep" knob in the same settings block, where `0` means "none", so the behavior is consistent rather than surprising.
- Not validated / out of scope: the request-only rewrite (not mutating stored history at all, rewriting only the outgoing copy) is the third part of #15495 and needs its own design discussion; it is untouched here. The full `npm run build` and the repo-wide suite were not run. `npm -w packages/cli run typecheck` reports 24 errors, in files this PR does not touch and which reproduce identically on `origin/main` at `6fb74164`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new schema properties are additive, and the runtime validation was already the source of truth.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15495

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让图片载荷驱逐（image payload eviction）可以关闭，并把运行时早已读取的 `model.chatCompression` 设置正式声明出来。

驱逐阈值现在接受 `0`，表示"永不把图片载荷从历史里改写掉"。为 `0` 时整个驱逐流程被跳过，因此存储的历史和发出去的请求都保留全部内联图片。

`model.chatCompression` 之前只声明为一个没有 properties 的空对象，导致 `imagePayloadThreshold`、`imageTokenEstimate`、`maxRecentFilesToRetain`、`maxRecentImagesToRetain`、`enableScreenshotTrigger`、`screenshotTriggerThreshold` 在设置帮助、校验和 IDE schema 里都不可见。现在按运行时解析函数已有的默认值和边界声明它们，并据此重新生成 IDE 的 JSON schema。设置参考文档补上了此前没写的驱逐阈值和图片 token 估算。

## 为什么需要

修复 #15495。需要历史里保留每一帧的视觉工作流，此前没有任何受支持的办法阻止驱逐：阈值只接受 >= 1 的整数，设一个很大的数只是没有文档的变通做法。未声明的设置也意味着这些开关从不出现在帮助或校验里。

## 审阅者验证步骤

1. `npm -w packages/core run build`
2. `npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` —— 761 个测试通过，其中两个是新增的：解析函数接受 `0`；阈值为 `0` 时，含三张内联图片的会话在持久历史和后续请求里都保留这三张。
3. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/config/` —— 2167 个测试通过，其中新增一条断言：`model.chatCompression` 的每个开关都按运行时边界声明。
4. 对改动文件跑 `npx prettier --check` 和 `eslint --max-warnings 0`。

### 证据

纯配置 / schema / 文档改动，无 UI，N/A。新增的 `llm-chat` 测试在移除 `imagePayloadThreshold > 0` 守卫后会失败，这正是它固定的回归点。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测；Windows、Linux 未测。

### 环境

本地构建 `packages/core` 加 vitest 单测；不涉及沙箱或真实模型端点。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：`0` 是这个开关新的可接受值，之前最小是 `1`。此前把 `0` 写进配置的用户会静默拿到默认值 `20`，现在会真的关闭驱逐。这与同一设置块里其他"保留多少个"的开关（`0` 表示不保留）的读法一致，因此是统一而非意外。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：#15495 的第三部分——不再改写存储历史、只改写发出的副本——需要单独的设计讨论，本 PR 未涉及。未跑完整 `npm run build` 和全仓测试。`npm -w packages/cli run typecheck` 报 24 个错误，都在本 PR 未触及的文件里，且在 `origin/main`（`6fb74164`）上完全一致地复现。
- 破坏性变更：无。新增的 schema 属性是追加式的，运行时校验本来就是唯一真相来源。

prs.title: feat(core): track model availability for the fallback chain (Qoder port)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ports the Qoder preview line's model-availability ledger into main as the first capability under the Option B integration decision (main's architecture wins; differentiated Qoder capabilities are ported as normal-sized PRs). It adds a session-scoped, per-model health state machine and, behind a new opt-in setting, teaches the model fallback chain to remember which models were just exhausted on capacity errors so it skips them for the rest of the turn and re-probes them once on the next turn. The turn boundary runs once per request at the send entry, and internal background sends (forked queries, speculation, side queries, suggestions) are excluded from the ledger so they neither disturb the live turn nor skip a recovered fallback. With the setting off, the fallback chain is byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Today the fallback chain is stateless per request: when the primary model exhausts its retry budget on a capacity error (429/503/529), every subsequent request in the same turn re-tries the same exhausted model from scratch before falling back again, wasting latency and quota. The ledger gives the chain cross-request memory within a turn. This is the first, smallest, self-contained capability chosen to establish the Option B porting workflow (design → baseline → implement → verify) before larger ports.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Unit: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/model-availability-service.test.ts` (10 tests: terminal not downgraded, sticky consumed once per turn, resetTurn/beginTurn re-probe). Preview's `selectFirstAvailable`/`reset` helpers are not ported — nothing in the fallback-skipping wiring calls them, so they would be dead surface.
- Retry threading: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/turn.test.ts -t 'forwards isExplicitRetry'` (Turn forwards the flag to the chat send options from its 10th positional slot) and `npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t 'explicit-Retry turn-boundary flag'` (a real `SendMessageType.Retry` sets the flag; a UserQuery does not).
- Wiring: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts -t 'sendMessageStream with retries'` (168 tests, gate off unchanged) — includes `-t 'skips a fallback exhausted earlier'` (gate on: same-turn skip + new-turn re-probe), `-t 'an explicit Retry re-probes'`, and the regression cases `-t 'forked'` (internal forked sends neither wipe the live turn nor fail on a skipped fallback), `-t 'Retry served by the primary'` (the turn boundary is hoisted to the request entry), and `-t 'gate off keeps'` (the gate is falsifiable with a real service injected).
- Gate / Config defaults: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'modelAvailabilityTracking'` (false default, constructor param, stable lazy service instance).
- CLI wiring: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'model availability tracking'` (opt-in/opt-out propagation + unset-by-default, mirroring the `unifiedAgentLoop` shape).
- Mutation witnesses (each restored byte-for-byte): deleting the fallback skip-check reds the gate-on test (`expected … 1 times, but got 2 times`); deleting the Retry `resetTurn` reds the Retry test (`expected … 2 times, but got 1 times`); deleting the CLI propagation line reds both CLI wiring tests; deleting the `isExplicitRetry` spread in `Turn.run` reds the forwarding test; forcing the client's 10th Turn argument to `false` reds the Retry call-site test; dropping the `!isInternalPromptId` exclusion reds both forked regression tests; removing the hoisted `resetTurn` reds the Retry-served-by-primary test; dropping the gate reds the gate-off test; Config `?? false` → `?? true` reds the default test and a fresh-instance getter reds the stability test.
- Full affected suites: `llm-chat.test.ts`, `turn.test.ts`, `client.test.ts`, core `config.test.ts`, cli `config.test.ts`; core + cli `tsc --noEmit` clean; settings schema regenerated.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI; behavior gated behind an opt-in setting).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests + `npm run build && npm run bundle`. A live headless E2E was attempted with a mock server returning capacity errors for the primary model; reaching the fallback chain requires exhausting the primary's internal retry budget, which the unit tests simulate directly via `maxRetries: 0`. The live run's persistent retry prevented reaching the fallback within the timeout, so the fallback-triggering evidence is the unit + mutation coverage above.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the ledger only affects fallback selection in this port; the primary model is still attempted first. Terminal/quota marking and the prompt-vs-silent policy map are deferred. Internal background sends are excluded from the ledger; the turn key is a single scalar, so the residual case of two genuine user turns sharing one Config concurrently fails open (re-probe = pre-PR behaviour); the design doc records this limitation.
- Not validated / out of scope: cross-session/account-wide health sharing; flipping the setting default; terminal/quota marking; live headless fallback-triggering E2E (see Environment).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; new opt-in setting `experimental.modelAvailabilityTracking` defaults to false.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

First capability ported under the Qoder→main integration's Option B decision (main architecture wins; port differentiated capabilities). No tracking issue is closed by this PR. Design: [English](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.zh-CN.md).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

把 Qoder preview 线的模型可用性台账移植进 main，作为选项 B 集成决策（main 架构赢、Qoder 差异化能力按正常粒度 PR 移植）下的首个能力。新增一个会话级、按模型的健康状态机，并在一个新的 opt-in 设置之下，让模型 fallback 链记住刚在容量错误上耗尽的模型，本轮剩余请求跳过它们、下一轮重探一次。轮边界在发送入口每请求执行一次，内部后台发送（forked 查询、speculation、side query、建议）被排除在台账之外，既不干扰正在进行的那一轮，也不跳过已恢复的 fallback。设置关闭时 fallback 链逐字节不变。

## 为什么需要

如今 fallback 链每请求无状态：主模型在容量错误（429/503/529）上耗尽重试预算后，同一轮的每个后续请求都从头重试同样耗尽的模型再 fallback，白白消耗时延与配额。台账给链上提供轮内跨请求记忆。这是为建立选项 B 移植流程（设计→基线→实现→验证）而选的首个最小、自包含能力，之后再做更大的移植。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 单测：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/model-availability-service.test.ts`（10 条：terminal 不降级、sticky 每轮消费一次、resetTurn/beginTurn 重探）。preview 的 `selectFirstAvailable`/`reset` 助手不移植——fallback-跳过接线中没有调用方，移植只会是死代码。
- Retry 穿线：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/turn.test.ts -t 'forwards isExplicitRetry'`（Turn 从第 10 个位置参数把标志透传到 chat send options）与 `npx vitest run src/core/client.test.ts -t 'explicit-Retry turn-boundary flag'`（真实 `SendMessageType.Retry` 会设上标志；UserQuery 不会）。
- 接线：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts -t 'sendMessageStream with retries'`（168 条，gate off 不变）——含 `-t 'skips a fallback exhausted earlier'`（gate on：同轮跳过 + 新轮重探）、`-t 'an explicit Retry re-probes'`，以及回归用例 `-t 'forked'`（内部 forked 发送既不擦除正在进行那一轮，也不因跳过 fallback 而失败）、`-t 'Retry served by the primary'`（轮边界提升到请求入口）、`-t 'gate off keeps'`（注入真实 service 时门可被证伪）。
- 门 / Config 默认值：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'modelAvailabilityTracking'`（false 默认、构造参数、稳定懒加载 service 单实例）。
- CLI 接线：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts -t 'model availability tracking'`（opt-in/opt-out 透传 + 默认 unset，镜像 `unifiedAgentLoop` 形状）。
- 变异见证（均字节级还原）：删 fallback 链跳过检查使 gate-on 用例红（`expected … 1 times, but got 2 times`）；删 Retry 的 `resetTurn` 使 Retry 用例红（`expected … 2 times, but got 1 times`）；删 CLI 透传行使两条 CLI 接线用例红；删 `Turn.run` 的 `isExplicitRetry` spread 使透传用例红；把 client 第 10 个 Turn 参数强制为 `false` 使 Retry 调用点用例红；删 `!isInternalPromptId` 排除使两条 forked 回归用例红；删提升后的 `resetTurn` 使 Retry-served-by-primary 用例红；删门使 gate-off 用例红；Config `?? false`→`?? true` 使默认值用例红、getter 每次新实例使 stability 用例红。
- 受影响全量套件：`llm-chat.test.ts`、`turn.test.ts`、`client.test.ts`、core `config.test.ts`、cli `config.test.ts`；core + cli `tsc --noEmit` 干净；settings schema 已重生成。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（非 UI；行为由 opt-in 设置门控）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测 |

### 环境（可选）

本地单测 + `npm run build && npm run bundle`。曾尝试用对 primary 返回容量错误的 mock server 做 live headless E2E；进入 fallback 链需耗尽 primary 的内部重试预算，单测通过 `maxRetries: 0` 直接模拟。live 运行的持久重试使其在超时内未能进入 fallback，故 fallback 触发的证据为上述单测 + 变异覆盖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：本次移植台账只影响 fallback 选择；primary 仍最先被尝试。terminal/quota 标记与 prompt-vs-silent 策略映射延后。内部后台发送被排除在台账之外；轮键是单个标量，故残余情形——共享同一 Config 的两个真实用户轮并发——会失败即放开（重探＝改动前行为）；设计文档记录了该局限。
- 未验证/范围外：跨会话/账号级健康共享；翻设置默认值；terminal/quota 标记；live headless fallback 触发 E2E（见环境）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；新增 opt-in 设置 `experimental.modelAvailabilityTracking` 默认 false。

设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Qoder→main 集成选项 B 决策（main 架构赢、移植差异化能力）下移植的首个能力。本 PR 不关闭任何跟踪 issue。设计文档：[英文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-model-availability-tracking.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(cli): show the resolved global directory in the permissions dialogs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The permissions dialog's "User settings" row now names the settings file the running process actually uses. The resolved global settings path is rendered through the existing `Saved in {{path}}` message and shortened to `~` for display, so a default install still reads `~/.qwen/settings.json` while a `QWEN_HOME` install reads its own path; long relocated paths are middle-compressed so the file name stays visible in the row at an 80-column terminal.

Both renderers are updated: the ink dialog and its OpenTUI parity copy. The hardcoded `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` message is retired, and `Saved in {{path}}` — which had no entry in any bundled locale, so the memory manager was silently falling back to English for that row — now exists in all nine locales and is listed in `MUST_TRANSLATE_KEYS`, so a future locale sync cannot drop it again without a failing test.

## Why it's needed

Addresses the dialog half of #15628. `Storage.getGlobalSettingsPath()` already honours `QWEN_HOME`, and the permissions dialog was the one place that ignored it: with `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen` the process reads `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json` while the User-settings row points at `~/.qwen/settings.json`. Because the row reads the resolved directory rather than a fixed string, it also follows the config-directory move planned in #15458 without another edit.

This is deliberately only the dialog half of the issue. The setting descriptions and the published VS Code schema are untouched: `scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` copies `setting.description` verbatim into the shipped schema, so interpolating a resolved path there would freeze the build machine's home directory into the artifact, and that half is coupled to #15458 anyway.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen npm run dev`, run `/permissions`, open the User settings scope → the row names `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`.
2. Unset `QWEN_HOME`, repeat → the row names `~/.qwen/settings.json`.
3. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.ts src/ui/components/PermissionsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/components/MemoryDialog.test.tsx` → all pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the parent commit, with the new assertions in place: `expected 'Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json' to be 'Saved in /var/folders/…/settings.json'` — both scope-item tests failed.

After: 13 tests in the OpenTUI permissions suite, 2 in the ink scope-item suite, and 17 in the memory dialog suite pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Windows was not run; the only platform-sensitive part is the separator, and both tests build their expectations from `path.sep`. The Linux run used a clean `node:22-bookworm` checkout of this branch.

### Environment (optional)

`packages/cli` unit tests on the host, plus the same suite in a `node:22-bookworm` container for the Linux check.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: nine locale entries change, because the old key is retired and the placeholder key is added. Rendering in every bundled language is unchanged for a default install — only the path itself now varies.
- Not validated / out of scope: no interactive TUI screenshot; the rendered description is covered through the exported scope-item helpers rather than through a full dialog render.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: a custom locale pack that translated `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` will no longer be consulted for this row; the bundled locales carry the new key.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15628 — this ships the dialog half only. The setting descriptions and the published VS Code schema stay open on the issue until that half lands.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

权限对话框里"用户设置"这一行，现在显示的是进程实际使用的设置文件。解析后的全局设置路径通过已有的 `Saved in {{path}}` 消息渲染，并做 `~` 缩写，因此默认安装仍显示 `~/.qwen/settings.json`，而设置了 `QWEN_HOME` 的安装会显示它自己的路径；被重定向到别处的长路径会做中间段压缩，保证在 80 列终端下文件名仍然可见。

两个渲染器都改了：ink 对话框和它的 OpenTUI 对等实现。硬编码的 `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` 消息被退役；而 `Saved in {{path}}` 原本在所有内置语言包里都没有条目，导致记忆管理器的那一行一直在悄悄回落成英文，现在九个语言包都补齐了，并已加入 `MUST_TRANSLATE_KEYS`，将来语言包同步若丢掉它，测试会直接变红。

## 为什么需要

处理 #15628 的对话框这一半。`Storage.getGlobalSettingsPath()` 本来就认 `QWEN_HOME`，权限对话框是唯一忽略它的地方：`QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen` 时进程读的是 `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`，而"用户设置"那一行却指向 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。由于这一行改为读取解析后的目录，它也会自动跟随 #15458 计划中的配置目录迁移，不需要再改一次。

这个 PR 刻意只做 issue 的对话框这一半。设置项描述和对外发布的 VS Code schema 没有动：`scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` 会把 `setting.description` 原样写进发布的 schema，在那里插值会把构建机的 home 目录固化进产物；而且那一半本来就依赖 #15458。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

prs.title: fix(cli): report pre-send refusals instead of replaying answers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the client refuses a turn before sending it — the session token limit or a UserPromptSubmit hook block — the stream carries no content, and the shared result builder fell back to the previous turn's assistant message. A persistent stream-json session therefore reported the refused message as a success carrying the earlier answer. This records the refusal on the adapter that stream-json, json, and text output share, and turns that would-be success into an error result with the refusal text and no `result` field. An error the caller already classified keeps its own subtype but reports the real refusal as its message, and the latch is cleared when the result that ends the turn is built, so it cannot relabel a later turn. A refusal that lands after the turn already streamed text leaves that text as the turn's answer and keeps the success envelope. The error reuses the existing `error_during_execution` subtype, so all three SDK protocol definitions stay unchanged and this does not depend on #15358.

## Why it's needed

Consumers branch on the result envelope (`is_error` / `subtype`), so a refused message currently looks answered and silently repeats stale content — a shell wrapper that only checks the status proceeds with the previous answer. The issue reproduces it with a two-message stream-json session, where the refused turn returned `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the adapter suite from `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`. The added cases feed each refusal event after a previous assistant message exists, then assert `is_error: true`, `subtype: "error_during_execution"`, the refusal text in `error.message`, and the absence of a `result` field. They also cover the neighbouring shapes: text produced before the refusal, a refusal in a later model round, a caller-classified error, and a refused turn followed by a turn that answers normally. Each case fails before the change and passes after it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the refused turn emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<previous answer>"}`. After: it emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}` with no `result`. This is a non-user-visible protocol change in headless output, so there is no TUI before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified inside a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows was not exercised, and the change has no platform-specific code.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the latch is cleared when a result is built and consumed by that same build, so it cannot relabel a later turn's result. Refusals still end the turn; in a single-shot `-p` run a refusal that has nothing of its own to report exits with code 1 so the process status agrees with the error envelope, while a refusal that lands after the turn streamed text keeps the success envelope and exits 0. A persistent `--input-format stream-json` session ignores the per-turn status and keeps its existing behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: the max-turns sibling refusal stays with #15358.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — no new subtype, no configuration, no SDK type change. Single-shot `-p` exit status for these two refusals changes from 0 to 1 for scripts that relied on the old value.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15704

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当客户端在发送前拒绝一轮请求（会话 token 上限，或 UserPromptSubmit hook 拦截）时，流里没有任何内容，而共用的 result 构建逻辑会回退到上一轮的助手消息。持久化的 stream-json 会话因此把被拒绝的消息报告成一次成功，并带上之前的答案。本改动在 stream-json、json、text 三种输出共用的适配器上记录拒绝原因，把原本会生成的成功结果转换成错误结果：带拒绝原因、不带 `result` 字段。调用方已经判定为错误的结果保留原有 subtype，但文案换成真实的拒绝原因；记录在构建 result 时清空，因此不会污染后续回合。拒绝发生时本轮已经输出过文本的，那段文本就是本轮的答案，结果保持成功信封。错误复用现有的 `error_during_execution` subtype，因此三套 SDK 的协议定义都不需要改，也不依赖 #15358。

## 为什么需要

调用方根据 result 信封（`is_error` / `subtype`）分支处理，现在被拒绝的消息看起来像已回答，并且静默重复旧内容——只判断退出码的 shell 包装脚本会拿着上一轮答案继续执行。issue 里用两条消息的 stream-json 会话复现：被拒绝的一轮返回 `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`。

## 评审验证方式

在 `packages/cli` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`。新增用例在已有上一轮助手消息的前提下注入拒绝事件，断言 `is_error: true`、`subtype: "error_during_execution"`、`error.message` 为拒绝原因，且没有 `result` 字段；同时覆盖相邻形态：拒绝前本轮已有文本、拒绝发生在后续模型轮次、调用方已判定的错误、以及被拒绝的一轮之后紧跟正常回答的一轮。这些用例改动前为红，改动后为绿。

## 改动前后

改动前被拒绝的一轮输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<上一轮答案>"}`；改动后输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}`，且不含 `result`。这是无头输出的协议行为变化，不涉及 TUI，因此没有界面前后对比。

## 测试环境

macOS 通过；Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器内通过；Windows 未验证，改动不含平台相关代码。

## 风险与范围

记录在构建 result 时清空、并被这次构建消费，不会污染后续回合。拒绝仍然结束回合：单次 `-p` 运行下没有自身输出的拒绝现在以退出码 1 结束、与错误信封一致；本轮已经有文本的拒绝保持成功信封、退出码 0。持久 `--input-format stream-json` 会话丢弃每轮状态、行为不变。max-session-turns 的同类处理仍归 #15358。没有新增 subtype、配置或 SDK 类型变更。单次 `-p` 下这两种拒绝的退出码由 0 变为 1，依赖旧值的脚本需要留意。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15704

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): reply to SDK initialize only after config is ready
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The SDK `initialize` control response is now sent after config initialization finishes, not right after the request is handled. The initialize request is still handled first, so its SDK MCP servers and staged SDK-only config are in place before extensions load. If config initialization fails, the request receives an error response instead of no reply at all.

In protocol terms, the frame's meaning changes from "request accepted" to "SDK mode is ready": a client may treat a successful `initialize` reply as permission to send its first prompt.

The deferred reply is bounded. `initializeSdkMode` derives its deadline from the client's own `timeout.controlRequest` (`sdkInitializeReplyTimeoutMs`, minus up to 5 s, halved for declared budgets below 10 s, and 55 s when none is declared), so `initialize` has three outcomes: a success frame once initialization finishes, an error frame carrying the initialization failure, and a success frame when the deadline passes first. The third case keeps the reply inside the client's budget without closing the query: both shipped clients treat an error reply as fatal, and initialization keeps running, readiness settles when it does, and prompts queued behind it are still served. The frame is informational; every prompt is still gated on `awaitConfigInitialized`.

## Why it's needed

`initialize` was answered before `config.initialize()` ran, so the reply only meant "request accepted". A client that sent its first prompt on that reply then blocked on readiness; when the shared extension store was locked by another process, it waited out the ~28s retry budget and surfaced "Extension store is busy". Making the reply wait for config initialization turns it into the readiness signal clients already assume it is, and gives initialization failures a place to be reported.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use the controlled repro from the issue: hold the `extension-store/lock` and start a stream-json SDK session.
2. Send `initialize`, then one user frame.
Before: `initialize` replies while the lock is still held, and the first prompt later fails with "Extension store is busy". After: the `initialize` reply arrives only once config initialization has completed, so a prompt sent after it no longer races extension loading. Release the lock before the initialize retry budget (~28 s) runs out, otherwise the initialize request receives the "Extension store is busy" error frame. If initialization fails for any other reason, the same request gets that error response.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so N/A for screenshots. `replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` fails on the previous ordering (reply sent while initialization is pending) and passes here; `replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` covers the new failure reply. Existing dispatch behaviour is unchanged and covered by `ControlDispatcher` tests, including the deferred failure path: with `deferResponse` the dispatcher must send nothing and leave the reply to the caller.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests on macOS and in a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows not exercised.

### Environment (optional)

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts` (106 tests: 65 + 41).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the initialize reply now includes config initialization latency, so clients that pipelined work on the old "accepted" ack see a later reply. That is the intended protocol meaning of the frame.
- The reply is bounded by the client's `timeout.controlRequest`: a client with a tight budget gets the deferred success frame before initialization finishes, so `initialize` keeps its "accepted, and the session is becoming ready" meaning rather than becoming a hard readiness gate. Measured on this branch with a declared 20 s budget and 22 s initialization, the frame arrived at ~16 s and the queued turn then started.
- Not validated / out of scope: the read path still takes the exclusive extension-store lock; concurrent sessions sharing one config dir can still serialize. Only the readiness ordering is changed here.
- Known pre-existing limitation, stated because the reply is now a readiness signal: duplicate `initialize` request ids. `registerIncomingRequest` overwrites the entry by id and a cancel answers only one frame, so the earlier caller waits out the SDK timeout. The registry behaviour is unchanged by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15796

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

SDK 的 `initialize` 控制应答现在在配置初始化完成之后才发送，而不是在请求被处理后立刻发送。初始化请求仍然最先被处理，因此它的 SDK MCP server 和暂存的 SDK 专用配置会在扩展加载前就位。如果配置初始化失败，该请求会收到错误应答，而不是完全收不到应答。

用协议语言说，这一帧的含义从「请求已接受」变成了「SDK 模式已就绪」：客户端可以把成功的 `initialize` 应答当作可以发送第一条 prompt 的许可。

这个延迟应答是有上限的。`initializeSdkMode` 的截止时间取自客户端自己声明的 `timeout.controlRequest`（`sdkInitializeReplyTimeoutMs`，最多减去 5 秒，声明的预算低于 10 秒时按一半扣；客户端未声明时为 55 秒），因此 `initialize` 有三种结果：初始化完成后的成功帧、携带初始化失败原因的错误帧，以及截止时间先到时返回的成功帧。第三种情况下初始化仍在继续，就绪状态会在其完成后落地，排在后面的 prompt 仍会被处理；该帧是信息性的 ack，不表示已就绪。

## 为什么需要

`initialize` 原先在 `config.initialize()` 运行之前就被应答，因此该应答只意味着「请求已接受」。据此发送第一条 prompt 的客户端随后会阻塞在就绪等待上；当共享的扩展存储在另一个进程中被占用时，它会等满约 28 秒的重试预算，然后抛出 "Extension store is busy"。让应答等待配置初始化，就把这个应答变成了客户端本就默认它具备的就绪信号，并且给初始化失败提供了上报位置。

## 审阅者验证方式

### 如何验证

1. 使用 issue 中的受控复现：占住 `extension-store/lock`，然后启动一个 stream-json SDK 会话。
2. 发送 `initialize`，然后发送一个用户帧。

修改前：`initialize` 在锁仍被占用时就应答，第一条 prompt 随后以 "Extension store is busy" 失败。修改后：`initialize` 应答只在配置初始化完成后到达，因此在其后发送的 prompt 不再与扩展加载竞争。请在 initialize 重试预算（约 28 秒）耗尽前释放锁，否则该 initialize 请求会收到 "Extension store is busy" 错误帧。如果初始化因其他原因失败，同一个请求会收到对应的错误应答。

### 证据（修改前后）

非 UI 改动，截图不适用。`replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` 在旧时序下失败（初始化仍未完成时就已应答），在本分支下通过；`replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` 覆盖了新的失败应答。既有的分发行为未变，由 `ControlDispatcher` 测试覆盖，包括延迟失败路径：使用 `deferResponse` 时分发器必须不发送任何内容，把应答留给调用方。

### 测试环境

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows     |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ✅  |

单元测试在 macOS 与 `node:22-bookworm` 容器中运行；未在 Windows 上验证。

### 环境（可选）

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts`（106 项测试：65 + 41）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：initialize 应答现在包含了配置初始化的耗时，因此按旧的「已接受」确认来流水线推进工作的客户端会看到更晚的应答。这正是该帧在协议上应有的含义。
- 应答受客户端 `timeout.controlRequest` 约束：声明了紧凑预算的客户端会在初始化完成前收到成功帧（信息性 ack，不关闭会话），会话在初始化完成后继续可用。在本分支上以 20 秒预算、22 秒初始化实测，该帧在约 16 秒时到达，排队的那个 turn 随后正常开始。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：读取路径仍会获取扩展存储的排他锁；共享同一配置目录的并发会话仍可能串行化。本次只改变就绪时序。
- 已知的既有局限（因为应答现在就是就绪信号，此处特别说明）：重复的 `initialize` 请求 id。`registerIncomingRequest` 按 id 覆盖条目，而取消只应答一帧，因此较早的调用方会等满 SDK 超时。该注册表行为不由本 PR 改变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Closes #15796

</details>
