prs.title: fix(web-shell): gate the automatic recap on general.showSessionRecap
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Web Shell's automatic session recap now reads the two `general` settings that describe it. It fires only when `general.showSessionRecap` is on, and it waits out the number of minutes set in `general.sessionRecapAwayThresholdMinutes` instead of a hardcoded 3. The manual `/recap` command is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Both settings already render in the companion's settings panel, so flipping either one wrote a value nothing read. The result was a panel that described a feature it could not control: a user who turned session recap off still got an automatic model call on every return to the tab, and a raised away threshold did nothing. `docs/design/session-recap/session-recap-design.md` gates the automatic trigger on `general.showSessionRecap`, default off, specifically so an ambient model call is never started without the user opting in.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the Web Shell with the daemon serving a session that has at least four transcript blocks.
2. In Settings, leave "Show Session Recap" off. Switch away from the tab for more than the threshold (default 5 minutes, or whatever `general.sessionRecapAwayThresholdMinutes` is set to) and come back: no `Recap: …` line is appended.
3. Turn the setting on and repeat: the recap appears on the next return, and a return before the threshold appends nothing.
4. From the running tab, change the threshold in Settings and confirm the next away period uses the new value without a reload.

Automated coverage: `npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t 'ecap|falls back to 5 minutes'` — 22 passed (the whole file is 1442); `-t "recap"` is case-sensitive and selects only the 19 pre-existing cases. The new case mounts with the setting off, turns it on through a re-render, and asserts the next return fires; removing `showSessionRecap` from the effect's dependency array turns it red.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not captured. This is a user-visible behaviour change and the section should hold a before/after recording of the two states described above; it is empty because the run that produced the current head only had a unit-test environment. Treat the automated cases as the evidence until a recording is added — a maintainer deciding from this section is deciding from nothing.

### Tested on

|            OS             | Status |
| :-----------------------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS                 |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows                |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux                 |   ⚠️   |

Only macOS was run locally. CI covers the rest.

### Environment (optional)

`npm run dev` in `packages/web-shell` against a mock daemon, plus the package's Vitest suite.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the trigger now also requires a new block count of at least 4 and an idle session, which is unchanged, so the only behaviour change is the gate and the threshold. A user who had recap working now gets no recap until they turn the setting on — that is the intent, but it is a visible change for anyone who relied on the untracked default.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full `App.test.tsx` suite was not run to completion; only the `recap` filter (19 tests) and the new case were. `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` reports 110 errors on `main` and the same 110 with this diff, so the change adds none, but the typecheck is not clean and was not made clean here. Windows and Linux were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Both settings already existed; this makes them effective.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13911

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 的自动会话回顾现在会读取描述它的两个 `general` 设置：只有 `general.showSessionRecap` 打开时才触发，并且等待 `general.sessionRecapAwayThresholdMinutes` 配置的分钟数，而不是写死的 3 分钟。手动的 `/recap` 命令不变。

## 为什么需要

这两个设置本来就会渲染在配套网页的设置面板里，所以改动它们的值写进去却没有任何代码读取。结果是一个描述了自己无法控制的功能的面板：关掉会话回顾的用户，每次切回标签页仍会触发一次自动模型调用；调高离开阈值的用户也没有任何效果。`docs/design/session-recap/session-recap-design.md` 要求自动触发必须由 `general.showSessionRecap`（默认关闭）门控，正是为了在用户没有明确选择加入时绝不发起环境性的模型调用。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开 Web Shell，让守护进程提供一个至少包含四条转录块的会话。
2. 在设置里保持「显示会话回顾」关闭。切走超过阈值（默认 5 分钟，或 `general.sessionRecapAwayThresholdMinutes` 设置的值）再切回：不会追加 `Recap: …` 行。
3. 打开该设置后重复：下一次返回会出现回顾，未达阈值的返回不会追加任何内容。
4. 在已打开的标签页里修改阈值，确认下一次离开按新值生效，且不需要刷新。

自动化覆盖：`npx vitest run client/App.test.tsx -t 'ecap|falls back to 5 minutes'` —— 22 项通过（整个文件 1442 项）；`-t "recap"` 区分大小写，只选中原有的 19 项。新增用例在设置关闭状态下挂载，通过一次重渲染打开设置，并断言下一次返回会触发；把 `showSessionRecap` 从 effect 的依赖数组里删掉后该用例变红。

### 证据（改前 / 改后）

未提供。这是用户可见的行为变更，本节应放上面两种状态的改前/改后录屏；目前为空，是因为产出当前 head 的那次运行只有单元测试环境。在补上录屏之前，请把自动化用例当作证据 —— 单凭这一节做判断的维护者实际上没有可判断的内容。

### 测试平台

|      操作系统      | 状态 |
| :---------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS         |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows        |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux         |  ⚠️  |

本地只跑了 macOS，其余由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

在 `packages/web-shell` 下用 `npm run dev` 对着 mock 守护进程，加上该包自己的 Vitest 套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：触发条件现在同样要求至少有 4 条新块且会话空闲（这部分未变），所以唯一的行为变化是设置门控和阈值。原本自动回顾生效的用户，在打开该设置之前将不再收到回顾 —— 这正是本意，但对依赖未受控默认值的人来说是一处可见变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：`App.test.tsx` 全量套件没有跑完，只跑了 `recap` 过滤（19 项）和新增用例。`tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` 在 `main` 上报告 110 个错误，带本改动后仍是同样的 110 个，因此本改动没有新增错误，但类型检查本身并不干净，也没有在本次修干净。Windows 和 Linux 未在本地运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。两个设置本来就有，本改动让它们真正生效。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #13911

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): share resident external Workspace across sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the resident external-Workspace increment: a Session that needs an external Workspace tool provisions one worker, and later Sessions and Turns reuse that same Workspace-scoped binding instead of each closing cycle destroying it. Closing one Session becomes a membership release rather than a teardown of the shared binding.

It also lands the admission machinery that increment needs — durable binding lookup, trusted-startup recovery and retirement paths that refuse active or `UNKNOWN` executions and never auto-replace a `LIVE` or indeterminate runtime, read-only dispatch that may run concurrently while writes stay fenced behind the binding, and `EPHEMERAL` sandbox-owned Workspace registration sharing the same admission, ownership, migration, schema-projection and inventory-eligibility rules as `EXTERNAL`.

165 files, +12122/−1826 against its own base, over 89 commits. The PR's base branch `feat/15512-completion` had itself been synced with `origin/main` by the author, and this merge brings its current tip `850a1bca` into the PR, so the diff no longer carries what the base already did: #17006's synchronous rename settlement replaces the delivery saga this branch had built, and the base's admission/fence extraction owns the shared fence vocabulary. The 24 conflicted files were resolved hunk by hunk against the merge base, and the round-21 evidence comment records every resolution, every accepted base retirement and the coverage that went with them. It does not restore the old monolithic module layout. Alongside the resident-Workspace machinery it carries the session-principal ownership migration this increment depends on: the new ownership table and principal model, the trusted actor context, principal-scoped overloads across the Session surfaces, and the unified read/write authority (a present ownership row is the sole authority; genuine legacy row-less Sessions stay tenant-wide, anonymous callers included). Review that half with the same care as the lifetime paths — it changes who may read, list and mutate an unbound Session.

## Why it's needed

Today a resident external Workspace cannot outlive the Session that first used it: close releases the binding and the next Session pays provisioning again, and concurrent readers are serialised behind the same fence as writers even when they cannot mutate anything.

The user-facing benefit is that a Workspace-scoped environment survives across Sessions and Turns with one provisioning, and that parallel read-only dispatch stops queueing behind writes. The recovery and retirement paths exist so that surviving longer does not become a safety problem: a binding whose state cannot be proven is refused rather than silently replaced.

## Reviewer Test Plan

The behaviour worth confirming is lifetime and refusal, not the happy path alone: a second Session reuses the first Session's binding, closing one Session does not tear down a binding another Session still uses, and an execution whose outcome is unknown blocks admission instead of being overwritten.

### How to verify

The MySQL-backed suites in `packages/managed-agent-server/verification` are where this is observable; they need MySQL 8.4. They are the first thing to run, and as of the base sync I do run the affected cases locally against a disposable MySQL 8.4 — the complete profile and the Hosted lanes stay CI's. The properties are `mysql.url` / `mysql.user` / `mysql.password`, not `mysql.host`; the fork-routing listener additionally requires `mysql.url.<fork>` for every fork, and `SessionOssStorageMySqlIT` needs its `qwen_o4_ci` database to exist before Maven connects:

```
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.url.1="<the same URL>" -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=... \
  -Dqwen.o4.mysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/qwen_o4_ci?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dqwen.o4.mysql.user=root
```

Expected: the external-Workspace retirement, recovery and shared-dispatch tests pass, and the refusal cases return the stable `workspace_close_execution_unsettled` / unavailable verdicts rather than a mapper error. Also worth checking by reading rather than running: that `WorkspaceMigrationAdmission` refuses an undecodable `registration_json` with that same verdict (it wraps `decodeRegistration` in a fail-closed catch).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — this is a backend and schema change with no user-visible surface.

Build and test evidence, run locally on the merged tree (macOS, JDK 21, disposable MySQL 8.4.11). Per-round detail, including what was not run, is in the round-21 evidence comment:

```
mvn -o -pl verification -am test-compile                        → exit 0
mvn -o -pl verification -am test -Dtest=<26 affected classes>   → exit 0, 1242 tests, 0 failures
mvn -o -pl verification -am test -Dtest=<5 contract classes> \
    checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle → exit 0, 100 tests, 30× "0 Checkstyle violations"
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
    -Dit.test=<3 affected MySqlIT>                              → exit 0, 74 tests on MySQL 8.4.11, SpotBugs 0 bugs
npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts <9 workflow meta-tests>
                                                              → exit 0, 778 passed, 38 skipped
```

On CI the `Build and verify reference distribution` job went **FAILURE → SUCCESS** across these fixes; before them it failed at `testCompile` with 14 errors, and separately the module carried 40 checkstyle violations that main does not have.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

✅ = the Maven and meta-test commands above, on macOS. ⚠️ = not run locally; Linux is covered by CI only.

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 for the compile, checkstyle, SpotBugs and focused unit gates, plus a disposable MySQL 8.4.11 for the affected `*MySqlIT` cases. The complete `mysql-integration` profile, the Hosted lanes and the TypeScript build/typecheck arm are CI's.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: reshaping Workspace binding lifetime and session-close semantics is the risky part — a bug here shows up as a Workspace being destroyed while another Session still uses it, or surviving when it should not. The recovery/retirement refusal paths are the guard, and they are the part most worth adversarial reading. It also edits the shared `V1__managed_schema.sql` baseline in place, which is this schema's declared policy before first release (`ManagedSchema.schemaVersion()` is hardcoded to 1 and reads only V1), so it needs no V2 — but it does mean an existing catalog is not migrated.
- Not validated / out of scope: runtime behaviour against a real managed provider and multi-Session concurrency end to end still need a deployed environment; I did not run those. The three MySQL cases most affected by this change now run locally and pass, but the rest of the `mysql-integration` profile and the Hosted lanes are CI's — and this PR's own checks never trigger them (#16942), so a manual `sdk-java.yml` dispatch is the only route to that evidence. The merged tree's TypeScript arm is not locally built or typechecked either. `EPHEMERAL` handling in UI-facing workspace summaries is a follow-up slice. No new public HTTP API is added around the trusted-host recovery and retirement operations.
- Class-size ratchet: after the base sync all 24 pins were re-measured against the merged tree with the ratchet test's own line count — 15 move down, 7 are unchanged and **two move up**: `JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository` 2319 → 2360 (+41) for the resident admission arms and storage-kind guards, and `RuntimeBrokerService` 1909 → 2028 (+119) for the resident recovery and durable binding-lookup entry points and their operation-fence helpers. Most of the decreases are slack the ceilings already had on the base, which the test cannot see because it only checks `lines <= ceiling`; they are not code this PR removed. The two raises are a visible exception to the discipline in `docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.md` (ceilings only ever go down), so they need an explicit decision rather than silent compliance: accept them and amend the rule in the same commit, or schedule the extractions as a follow-up. Both pins carry that annotation. `GLOBAL_MAX_LINES` is 2549 on this base — the base lowered it from 2662 — and both raised classes stay well under it. I did not extract lines out of either class at this review round.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the ownership migration adds the `ma_session_principal` table to the schema baseline and changes the operation identity digest shape; a deployment that predates this branch needs a fresh catalog (the schema's standing pre-release constraint), and operations recorded under the old digest shape do not replay after the upgrade — pre-release compatibility only, tracked as a follow-up. Anonymous legacy read/write on genuine row-less Sessions is unchanged; row-bearing Sessions are owner-scoped for every caller including anonymous ones. Actorless creation of a **new** unbound Session is closed: every creation route requires the trusted actor principal (the packaged-HTTP test lanes authenticate through the local trusted-actor-header stand-in).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15512, #15247.

Stacked on #15684, whose head branch `feat/15512-completion` is this PR's base — **it must not merge before #15684**.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

落地「常驻外部 Workspace」增量：某个 Session 首次需要外部 Workspace 工具时创建一次 worker，之后的其他 Session 与 Turn 复用同一个 Workspace 作用域的绑定，而不是每个关闭周期都把它销毁。关闭单个 Session 变成成员释放，而不再拆除共享绑定。

同时补齐这套机制所需的准入逻辑：持久化绑定查询、可信启动的恢复与退役路径（拒绝 active 或 `UNKNOWN` 执行，且绝不自动替换 `LIVE` 或状态不确定的 runtime）、只读派发可在写操作被围栏保护的前提下并发执行，以及沙箱自有的 `EPHEMERAL` Workspace 注册与 `EXTERNAL` 共用同一套准入、归属、迁移、schema 投影与清单资格规则。

相对自身 base 为 165 个文件，+12122/−1826，共 89 个提交。本 PR 的 base 分支 `feat/15512-completion` 此前已由作者同步过 `origin/main`，本次 merge 把它的当前 tip `850a1bca` 并入 PR，因此 diff 不再携带 base 已经做过的部分：#17006 的同步 rename 结算取代了本分支原先建的 delivery saga，base 的 admission/fence 拆分接管了共享 fence 词汇。24 个冲突文件逐块对照 merge base 解决，round-21 证据评论记录了每一处解决、每一项接受的 base 退役以及随之消失的覆盖。不恢复旧的单体模块布局。除常驻 Workspace 机制外，本 PR 同时携带其依赖的 session-principal 所有权迁移：新增归属表与 principal 模型、可信 actor 上下文、遍布 Session 各面的 principal 重载，以及统一读写授权（存在归属行时该行是唯一权威；真正的 legacy 无行 Session 保持租户内可见，含匿名调用者）。请与生命周期路径同等仔细地评审这一半 —— 它改变了谁可以读取、列出和修改未绑定 Session。

## 为什么需要

目前常驻外部 Workspace 无法比首个使用它的 Session 活得更久：关闭即释放绑定，下一个 Session 要重新付出创建成本；而且即使读操作不可能改变任何状态，也要和写操作排在同一个围栏后面。

对用户的价值是：Workspace 作用域的环境可以跨 Session 与 Turn 存活，只需一次创建；并行只读派发不再被写操作阻塞。恢复与退役路径的存在，是为了让"活得更久"不变成安全问题：状态无法证明的绑定会被拒绝，而不是被悄悄替换。

## 评审验证计划

值得确认的是生命周期与拒绝语义，而不只是正常路径：第二个 Session 复用第一个 Session 的绑定；关闭其中一个 Session 不会拆掉另一个 Session 仍在使用的绑定；结果未知的执行会阻塞准入而不是被覆盖。

### 如何验证

可观测的地方在 `packages/managed-agent-server/verification` 下的 MySQL 用例，它们需要 MySQL 8.4。它们是首先要跑的部分；自 base 同步起，受影响的用例我已在本机一次性 MySQL 8.4 上实跑，完整 profile 与 Hosted 各 lane 仍归 CI。属性是 `mysql.url` / `mysql.user` / `mysql.password`，不是 `mysql.host`；fork 路由监听器还要求每个 fork 都有 `mysql.url.<fork>`，且 `SessionOssStorageMySqlIT` 需要 `qwen_o4_ci` 库在 Maven 连接前就已存在：

```
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
  -Dmysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dmysql.url.1="<the same URL>" -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=... \
  -Dqwen.o4.mysql.url="jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/qwen_o4_ci?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false" \
  -Dqwen.o4.mysql.user=root
```

预期：外部 Workspace 的退役、恢复与共享派发用例通过；各类拒绝场景返回稳定的 `workspace_close_execution_unsettled` / unavailable 判定，而不是 mapper 报错。另外有一处靠阅读即可核对：`WorkspaceMigrationAdmission` 对无法解码的 `registration_json` 会用同一个判定拒绝（它把 `decodeRegistration` 包在 fail-closed 的 catch 里）。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

UI 层面 N/A —— 这是后端与 schema 改动，没有用户可见界面。

构建与测试证据，在合并后的树上本地实测（macOS，JDK 21，一次性 MySQL 8.4.11）。逐轮明细与未运行项见 round-21 证据评论：

```
mvn -o -pl verification -am test-compile                        → exit 0
mvn -o -pl verification -am test -Dtest=<26 affected classes>   → exit 0, 1242 tests, 0 failures
mvn -o -pl verification -am test -Dtest=<5 contract classes> \
    checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle → exit 0, 100 tests, 30× "0 Checkstyle violations"
mvn -o -Pmysql-integration -pl verification -am verify \
    -Dit.test=<3 affected MySqlIT>                              → exit 0, 74 tests on MySQL 8.4.11, SpotBugs 0 bugs
npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts <9 workflow meta-tests>
                                                              → exit 0, 778 passed, 38 skipped
```

CI 上 `Build and verify reference distribution` 在这批修复前后由 **FAILURE → SUCCESS**：此前它卡在 `testCompile` 的 14 个错误，另外该模块还带着 40 处 main 上并不存在的 checkstyle 违规。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

✅ = 上面那些 Maven 与元测试命令，在 macOS 上执行；⚠️ = 本地未运行，Linux 仅由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

本地 JDK 21 跑编译、checkstyle、SpotBugs 与聚焦单测门禁，另加一次性 MySQL 8.4.11 跑受影响的 `*MySqlIT` 用例。完整 `mysql-integration` profile、Hosted 各 lane 与 TypeScript 构建/类型检查臂归 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：重塑 Workspace 绑定生命周期与 Session 关闭语义是风险所在 —— 出问题时表现为"另一个 Session 还在用，Workspace 却被销毁"，或"本该销毁却存活"。恢复与退役的拒绝路径就是护栏，也是最值得对抗性阅读的部分。此外它原地修改了共享的 `V1__managed_schema.sql` 基线，这是本 schema 在首次发布前声明的策略（`ManagedSchema.schemaVersion()` 硬编码为 1，且只读取 V1），因此不需要 V2；但这也意味着已存在的 catalog 不会被迁移。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：真实 managed provider 下的运行行为与多 Session 端到端并发仍需部署环境，这些我没有运行。受本次改动影响最大的三个 MySQL 用例现已在本机实跑并通过，但 `mysql-integration` profile 的其余部分与 Hosted 各 lane 归 CI —— 而本 PR 自身的 checks 从不触发它们（#16942），因此手动 dispatch `sdk-java.yml` 是拿到那份证据的唯一途径。合并后树的 TypeScript 臂也未在本机构建或做类型检查。UI 侧 workspace 摘要中的 `EPHEMERAL` 处理属于后续切片。可信主机使用的恢复与退役操作没有新增公开 HTTP API。
- 类大小棘轮：base 同步后，24 个 pin 全部用棘轮测试自己的行数口径对合并树重新实测 —— 15 个下调、7 个不变、**2 个上调**：`JdbcRuntimeBindingRepository` 2319 → 2360（+41），用于常驻 admission 臂与 storage-kind 守卫；`RuntimeBrokerService` 1909 → 2028（+119），用于常驻恢复与持久绑定查询入口及其 operation fence 辅助方法。多数下调是 ceiling 在 base 上本就留有的余量（测试只检查 `lines <= ceiling`，看不到这种松弛），并不是本 PR 删掉的代码。这两个上调是对 `docs/design/2026-11-04-managed-agent-class-size-ratchet.md` 中「ceiling 只降不升」纪律的显式例外，需要明确决定而不是默认合规：接受上调并在同一提交里修改规则，或把拆分排为后续项。两个 pin 上都已注明。`GLOBAL_MAX_LINES` 在本 base 上是 2549（base 从 2662 下调），两个上调的类都远低于它。我没有在这个评审轮次里从这两个类中拆出任何行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：所有权迁移在 schema 基线中新增 `ma_session_principal` 表，并改变操作身份摘要的形状；早于本分支的部署需要全新 catalog（该 schema 发布前的既有约束），旧摘要形状下记录的操作在升级后不再重放 —— 仅限预发布兼容性，已记为后续项。真正无归属行的 legacy Session 的匿名读取/写入不变；带归属行的 Session 对所有调用者（含匿名）都是 owner 作用域。**新建**未绑定 Session 的无 actor 创建已关闭：所有创建路由都要求可信 actor principal（packaged-HTTP 测试车道通过本地 trusted-actor-header 替身完成鉴权）。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #15512、#15247，不自动关闭。

堆叠在 #15684 之上，其 head 分支 `feat/15512-completion` 即本 PR 的基础分支 —— **必须先合并 #15684**。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): surface a session-artifact header entry before the replay on cold open
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a session-level artifact entry to the chat header that shows the session's artifact count and opens the artifact list. The session restore response now carries the restored artifact snapshot, and the client commits it in its own render before the conversation replay is injected, so the entry paints ahead of the conversation body on a cold open. The entry opens the environment panel's artifacts section, which lists the session's artifacts. The per-turn artifact chips are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

On a cold session open, artifacts were only reachable through the per-turn chips, which require the replay to render and sit under the turn that created them — often scrolled out of view. There was no quick, always-visible way to see that a session has artifacts and jump to them. Measurements on a real session showed the artifact list was already fetched by the time the body painted, so the gap was not the artifact fetch itself but the absence of an early, session-level entry. This surfaces the count in the header roughly 150 ms before the body and gives a one-click path to the artifact list.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Cold-open a session that has published artifacts (evict it first so the load is a true restore). Confirm the header artifact entry appears before the conversation body with the correct count, and that clicking it opens the environment panel with the artifacts listed. Repeat on a session with no artifacts (no entry shown) and against an older daemon that does not embed the snapshot (entry still appears via the existing gated artifact fetch, i.e. with the body). Confirm the per-turn chips are unchanged and that session restore latency is not increased.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Headless Chromium against an isolated daemon running this build, cold-opening a session with 3 published artifacts, three runs: header entry painted 140–166 ms before the conversation body; clicking the entry opened the environment panel and the artifact titles went from 0 to 3 occurrences (all 3 artifacts listed). Before this change there was no header entry at all. Unit suites pass: artifact store 223, artifact hook 19, session provider 530. Typecheck is clean for all touched files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local isolated daemon from the bundled build; headless Chromium driving the real Web Shell; unit tests via vitest. Full monorepo build on this checkout is blocked by a pre-existing dependency drift (zod / @types/diff) unrelated to this change; the touched packages typecheck cleanly and CI installs the pinned lockfile.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the early snapshot is committed with a forced synchronous render so it can paint before the replay; it may briefly show stale workspace status until the normal gated artifact fetch refreshes it. The entry is a count/list shortcut, so this is acceptable and self-corrects.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not exercised locally; embedding an artifact summary in the session-list metadata for click-time display is a deliberate follow-up, not included here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The embedded field is optional; older daemons omit it and clients fall back to the existing gated fetch, and older clients ignore it.

Design document: [English](docs/design/2026-11-15-early-session-artifact-entry.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-15-early-session-artifact-entry.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在聊天头部新增一个会话级产物入口，显示本会话产物数量并可打开产物列表。会话恢复响应现在携带已恢复的产物快照，客户端在对话 replay 注入之前以一次独立渲染提交它，使该入口在冷开时先于对话正文绘制。入口打开环境面板的 artifacts 区，其中列出本会话产物。按轮产物芯片保持不变。

## 为什么需要

冷开会话时，产物此前只能通过按轮芯片触达，而按轮芯片需要 replay 渲染、且挂在创建它的那一轮下——常被滚出视口。没有一个快捷、常驻可见的方式让用户知道会话有产物并跳转过去。在真实会话上的实测表明，artifact 列表在正文绘制时就已拉取到位，因此差距不在 artifact 拉取本身，而在于缺少一个早到的会话级入口。本改动把数量显示在头部，约比正文早 150ms，并提供一键直达产物列表的路径。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

冷开一个有已发布产物的会话（先驱逐使其成为真正的冷恢复）。确认头部产物入口先于对话正文出现、数量正确，点击后打开环境面板并列出产物。在无产物会话（不显示入口）以及不内嵌快照的旧 daemon（入口经既有门控 artifact 拉取仍会出现，即与正文同帧）上重复。确认按轮芯片不变、会话恢复时延未增加。

### 证据（前后对比）

Headless Chromium 对运行本构建的隔离 daemon，冷开一个含 3 个已发布产物的会话，三轮：头部入口比对话正文早 140–166ms 绘制；点击入口打开环境面板，产物标题出现次数从 0 变为 3（3 个产物全部列出）。改动前完全没有头部入口。单测通过：artifact store 223、artifact hook 19、会话 provider 530。所有改动文件 typecheck 干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测 |

prs.title: fix(cli): keep tool-result markdown when the result fits its height budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stops demoting a tool result to plain text just because the message carries a terminal-height budget. The plain-text fallback in `ToolMessage` exists to bound a result that is too tall for the space it has, because that path runs through `MaxSizedBox`; it was also firing for results that fit the budget whole, which cost them their formatting for no height reason. The decision is now made on the result's rendered height, measured with the same rendered-height estimator `MarkdownDisplay` pre-slices with, so the markdown branch and the fallback agree about what "fits".

Shell output keeps the plain-text path whenever its output is on screen, because the `ui.shellOutputMaxLines` cap renders and counts its hidden lines through `MaxSizedBox` and the ANSI path draws the `ShellStatsBar` overflow count. `ShellTool` itself declares its output as not markdown, so that branch now only pins the reason instead of relying on the height budget to imply it.

## Why it's needed

In the interactive CLI, a completed `ask_user_question` answer summary shows `**Color**: Blue` instead of a bold label. Every tool result two lines tall lost its markdown the moment a height budget was present, which is the normal state for a message in a 100x24 terminal — long before anything actually needed truncating. The issue's own note puts it the same way: "ToolMessage disables Markdown whenever a terminal-height budget is present, even for short results."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Ask `ask_user_question` a question, answer it, and look at the completed tool result: it should show a bold **Color** label rather than the literal `**` markers. A result taller than the budget still falls back to plain text and still shows the "... first N lines hidden ..." marker, and shell output is still capped and still reports its hidden-line count.

The new tests in `ToolMessage.test.tsx` cover all three shapes: a short result renders through the markdown renderer under a 20-row budget, a 40-line result under the same budget does not, and shell output under the same budget stays on the plain-text path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not captured as a screenshot: this worktree cannot build the CLI bundle (see Environment), so the change is verified by component tests rather than a tmux capture. Before the change, the first new test fails (the result renders as plain text); after it, all 105 tests in the file pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

`npx vitest run src/ui/components/messages/ToolMessage.test.tsx` from `packages/cli`, with the package's `globalSetup` prerequisite guard stubbed out (the worktree has no built `acp-bridge` / `web-templates` / channel `dist/`). No runtime was launched.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: any non-shell tool whose output is long enough to overflow its budget now renders as plain text on the same rule as before, but the boundary is a rendered-height estimate rather than "any budget at all". A result just under the estimate keeps markdown and relies on `MarkdownDisplay`'s own slice, which uses the identical estimator, so the two can only disagree if the estimator itself is wrong for a block the renderer measures differently (tables and code fences are the two cases the estimator already handles specially).
- Not validated / out of scope: no interactive run; Windows and Linux untested. The full `npm run build` does not complete in this worktree, so typechecking was limited to `packages/cli` (`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` reports no error in either changed file; the 10 errors it prints are unresolved `@qwen-code/acp-bridge/*` subpaths that this worktree cannot build).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13956

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

不再因为消息带终端高度预算就把工具结果降级成纯文本。`ToolMessage` 里的纯文本回退是为了把**过高**的结果限制在可用空间内（那条路径走 `MaxSizedBox`），但它也会对整段放得下的结果生效，让它们白白丢掉格式。现在改为按结果的**渲染高度**决定，用的估算函数和 `MarkdownDisplay` 预裁剪时所用的是同一个，因此 markdown 分支和回退分支对"是否放得下"的判断一致。

## Reviewer 验证方式

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：任何非 shell 工具的输出，只要超过预算，仍然和以前一样会变成纯文本，但边界从"只要有预算"变成了一个渲染高度估算。刚好在估算之下的结果会保留 markdown 并依赖 `MarkdownDisplay` 自身的裁剪，而它用的是同一个估算函数，所以两者只可能在渲染器对某个块的度量与估算不一致时出现分歧（表格和代码围栏是估算函数已特殊处理的两类）。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有做交互式运行；Windows 和 Linux 未测试。这个 worktree 里完整 `npm run build` 跑不完，所以类型检查只覆盖了 `packages/cli`（`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` 对两个改动文件均无报错；它输出的 10 条错误都是本 worktree 无法构建的 `@qwen-code/acp-bridge/*` 子路径）。

prs.title: fix(cli): surface the session turn limit in JSON and stream-json output
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A `stream-json` session that goes past `model.maxSessionTurns` ends without a model request: the client yields `MaxSessionTurns` and returns an empty turn, so the run emitted a normal successful `result` that repeated the previous message's answer. The adapter now records the refusal, and the run reports it as an error result: subtype `error_max_turns`, `is_error: true`, exit code 53, no repeated answer.

## Why it's needed

Nothing in the output said the turn was refused, so SDK clients and CI agents could not tell it from a real answer. The diagnostic system marker is still emitted, so a consumer sees both the limit and the reason.

`SessionTokenLimitExceeded` has the same shape — a turn refused before any model request — and was dropped by the same `switch`. It gets the same treatment, with subtype `error_during_execution` and exit 1 (the code the drain path already returns for it), so the token cap no longer reports the previous answer as a success.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- The refusal is sampled once the main turn's stream ends. A drain item runs its own end-of-run path (`routeAbort` / `handleMaxTurnsExceededError` for the shared loop), and this change leaves it alone.
- The shared agent loop already exits 53 through its `max_session_turns` stop reason and is unchanged. It matters because the default loop runs one `runNonInteractive` per stream-json message, so its result envelope now differs from the previous behaviour.
- `integration-tests/cli/agent-loop-parity.test.ts` is updated: it pinned the old "success that repeats the answer" contract for the default loop.

```sh
npx vitest run src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts src/utils/errors.test.ts src/nonInteractive/io/
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

- 541 passed, 1 skipped.
- The four new cases (turn cap and token cap, in JSON and stream-json) fail when the `refusedTurn` branch is removed and pass with it, so they are load-bearing.
- `npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint` on the changed files — clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; no dev server or sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a stream-json consumer that treated a refused turn as a successful result now receives `is_error: true` and exit code 53 (1 for the token cap). That is the intended contract change, and it is the reason the parity test asserted the old shape.
- Not validated / out of scope: `integration-tests/cli/agent-loop-parity.test.ts` was **not run**: it spawns `dist/cli.js`, and a full build does not complete in my worktree. `packages/core` fails `tsc --build` on pre-existing errors (`ignore` / `mime/lite` typings resolved through a shared `node_modules`, same root cause as the `node:tls` / `minimatch` errors `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli` reports), and `packages/browser-use` fails its playwright-core version check. The updated assertions follow the harness output shape but are unverified.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: JSON and stream-json consumers should treat `error_max_turns` and the token-cap error as refused turns rather than answers.
- Not run: the full `npm run build`.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15325

prs.title: feat(telemetry): record OpenRouter routing backend and generation id
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Records two OpenRouter routing attributes on the `qwen-code.llm_request` span: `openrouter.provider`, the backend that actually served the request, and `openrouter.generation_id`, the `X-Generation-Id` response header. Both are read from the raw wire — the response headers and the un-normalized response body or SSE chunk — because the OpenAI converter builds a fresh response from a fixed field whitelist and drops them before telemetry ever sees them.

The non-streaming path now takes its completion through the SDK's `withResponse()` so the raw `Response` is reachable, falling back to a plain await when the client does not expose it. Writes go through a new `GenAiExchangeController.recordResponseAttribute`, which refuses to touch a finalized attempt or a handle from another generation.

## Why it's needed

OpenRouter rotates requests across backend providers, and which backend answered is often exactly what explains a difference in speed, cost, or output quality. OpenRouter reports that decision on every response, but today an external observer of Qwen Code's telemetry can see that something answered via `openrouter.ai` and never which backend. Issue #14629 asks for the two values, and both halves are needed for the routing decision to be usable: the provider for the immediate answer, the generation id because it is the key to OpenRouter's own per-generation cost and latency lookup.

The attributes are vendor-prefixed rather than folded into `gen_ai.provider.name`, which already means the gateway/protocol provider (e.g. `gcp.gemini`); overloading it would silently change the meaning of an emitted field.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Point a config at `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` with telemetry enabled and run a prompt; the `qwen-code.llm_request` span should carry both attributes. Without an OpenRouter key, the behavior is covered by unit tests: header capture, body/chunk capture with first-non-empty-wins, and the hostname gate that keeps a non-OpenRouter endpoint from emitting either attribute even when its payload carries the same field names.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI change; this only adds span attributes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

Unit tests only; no live OpenRouter traffic was exercised.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the non-streaming path now goes through `withResponse()` instead of a plain await. Mocked and proxy-compatible clients that lack the method take the same await path as before, and the existing suite covers that fallback; a client whose `withResponse()` resolves an unexpected shape would now fail where it previously succeeded.
- Not validated / out of scope: not exercised against live OpenRouter traffic, so the upstream contract (that `provider` appears on every chunk and `X-Generation-Id` on every response) is taken from the report rather than re-verified here. Full `npm run build` was not run; the core package typecheck, eslint, and prettier are clean on the changed files.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New span attributes are additive and only emitted on an OpenRouter hostname.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14629

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 `qwen-code.llm_request` span 上记录两个 OpenRouter 路由属性：`openrouter.provider`（实际服务该请求的后端 provider）与 `openrouter.generation_id`（响应头 `X-Generation-Id`）。两者都从原始网络层读取 —— 响应头，以及未经归一化的响应体或 SSE chunk —— 因为 OpenAI converter 会用固定的字段白名单重建响应对象，它们在进入遥测之前就被丢弃了。

非流式路径现在通过 SDK 的 `withResponse()` 取得补全结果，从而能拿到原始 `Response`；客户端没有该方法时退回普通 await。写入统一走新增的 `GenAiExchangeController.recordResponseAttribute`，它会拒绝向已 finalize 的 attempt 或属于其他 generation 的 handle 写入。

## 为什么需要

OpenRouter 会把请求轮转分发到多个后端 provider，而究竟是哪个后端应答，往往正是速度、成本或输出质量差异的原因。OpenRouter 在每个响应里都会报告这个决策，但今天观察 Qwen Code 遥测的外部系统只能看到「某个后端通过 `openrouter.ai` 应答」，看不到是哪一个。

属性采用厂商前缀，而不是并入 `gen_ai.provider.name` —— 后者已有确定含义（网关/协议 provider，如 `gcp.gemini`），复用会静默改变一个已发布字段的语义。

## 评审验证方式

把配置指向 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` 并开启遥测，跑一次提问，`qwen-code.llm_request` span 应同时带有两个属性。没有 OpenRouter key 时，行为由单测覆盖：响应头采集、响应体/chunk 采集（取第一个非空值）、以及 hostname 门禁 —— 即使非 OpenRouter 端点的 payload 里有同名字段，也不会发出这两个属性。

Before/After：不适用，没有用户可见或 TUI 变更，仅新增 span 属性。

仅在 macOS 上跑了单测；未使用真实 OpenRouter 流量验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：非流式路径改用 `withResponse()`，不再是普通 await。缺少该方法或被 mock 的客户端仍走原来的 await 分支，既有测试覆盖了该回退；若某客户端的 `withResponse()` 返回了非预期结构，原本能成功的请求现在会失败。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：未对真实 OpenRouter 流量验证，`provider` 出现在每个 chunk、`X-Generation-Id` 出现在每个响应这两点取自 issue 报告而非本轮复验。未运行完整 `npm run build`；core 包的类型检查、eslint、prettier 在改动文件上均干净。
- 破坏性变更：无。新增 span 属性是纯增量的，且只在 OpenRouter hostname 下发出。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): add ui.startExpanded to start the TUI in expanded detail mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `ui.startExpanded` (boolean, default `false`). When `true`, the terminal UI starts with thinking blocks and tool output expanded instead of requiring Ctrl+O / Alt+T in every session.

The setting only seeds the initial value of the existing app-wide expansion flag. The toggle still owns the state afterwards, so Ctrl+O in an expanded session collapses it exactly as before. Both renderers are covered (ink `AppContainer`, OpenTUI `start-opentui-ui`).

```json
{ "ui": { "startExpanded": true } }
```

## Why it's needed

Retiring `ui.compactMode` left no way to express "I always want the reasoning visible", so the only option was to press the toggle at the start of each session. This restores that preference as a start-up default rather than a mode the toggle has to fight.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
npx vitest run src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx       282 passed
npx vitest run src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts   67 passed
npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli                  clean
eslint / prettier --check on all five changed files  clean
```

The two new `AppContainer` cases are `startExpanded: true` seeds `allExpanded` and unset keeps it `false`. Reverting the `AppContainer.tsx` change turns the first one red (`expected false to be true`).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The setting only seeds the initial value, so it cannot conflict with the toggle. A user who never presses Ctrl+O now sees reasoning from the first frame, which is the intent of the option.
- Not validated / out of scope: No manual run of the interactive TUI with `ui.startExpanded: true` — the behaviour is asserted through the context value the renderers read, not through a live terminal session. prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Web Shell commit view can now commit a subset of the dirty files. It lists every uncommitted file with a checkbox, preselects all of them, and sends the selection with the commit. Unchecked files stay in the working tree, and work the user had already staged outside the selection stays staged instead of being swept in.

Underneath, the shared commit helper and the daemon commit route gained a `paths` option next to the existing `all` flag. The dialog no longer uses `all: true`; it always sends an explicit selection, and refuses to commit when nothing is selected instead of letting git fail on an empty pathspec.

Renames are handled explicitly: either half of a rename selects the pair, because git only records the rename when the deletion and the addition land in the same commit.

## Why it's needed

The commit view always committed everything. A single session that produced two unrelated changes (a bug fix and a refactor, say) could only be split into clean commits from a terminal, which defeats the point of having the dialog. The issue asks for per-file checkboxes so the Web Shell git workflow matches what the CLI already allows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit and route tests cover the new behavior; no manual UI session was run. Reproduce the original gap by opening the commit view with two dirty files and pressing Commit — before this change both files are in the commit, after it only the checked ones are, and unchecking all of them surfaces a "select at least one file" error instead of a daemon call.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no screenshot or recording was captured for this run.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Tests and lint run locally on macOS from a linked worktree; no `npm run dev` session.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the dialog now depends on the diff listing to build a selection. If the list is empty or fails to load, it refuses to commit rather than falling back to committing everything, so a broken diff route blocks committing from the dialog (the CLI is unaffected).
- Not validated / out of scope: no manual UI verification on a running daemon, and no full `npm run build`. `packages/cli` typecheck was not run (fresh worktree reports unrelated TS6305 on unbuilt workspace dependencies); `packages/core` typecheck passes. `packages/web-shell` typecheck reports only the 12 known stale-SDK errors, which are identical on `origin/main`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `all: true` keeps its previous semantics.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8446

prs.title: test(acp-bridge): pin a granted conditional close actually tearing the session down
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two bridge tests that pin the granted half of the conditional close. The explicit-path case spawns a session on a child that negotiated active work and answers a `sessionClose` probe for `onlyIfUnheld` with `{closed: true, holds: []}`, calls `closeSession(id, undefined, {closeIfUnheld: true, reason: 'scheduled_task_deleted'})`, and asserts three outcomes: `sessionCount === 0`, exactly one `closeIfUnheld` probe was sent, and the emitted `session_closed` event carries `reason: 'scheduled_task_deleted'`.

On the explicit path the reason is pinned as a literal rather than read back from the caller's `closeOpts`. `closeSessionImpl` re-emits `closeOpts.reason ?? 'client_close'`, so a read-back would let both sides move together and would stay green if the hand-off were dropped.

That explicit path cannot witness the `reason: opts.closeReason` hand-off in `closeIfChildUnheld`, because the spread of `closeOpts` already carries the same literal. The second test, `emits the detach reason when a detached session closes unheld`, closes a detached session with no `closeOpts`, so the hand-off is the only source of the reason and dropping it turns that case red.

There are no production code changes.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14389 Item 1 records that the conditional close added in #14276 has no coverage for the outcome it exists to serve. All five sites that assert on `closeIfUnheld` either exercise a refusal or check the option bag against a stub that closes unconditionally, so a granted close that silently failed to tear anything down would stay green.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the bridge suite and confirm both new cases pass:

```
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridge.test.ts
```

Then confirm each test bites. Replacing `reason: opts.closeReason` with `reason: 'client_close'` in the `closeIfUnheld` branch makes the detach case fail with `expected 'client_close' to be 'last_client_detached'`; it was reverted before commit. Invert the assertion on `sessionCount` in the explicit-path case instead and that one fails there too.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a test-only change; the observable behaviour of the bridge is unchanged.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS host, `npx vitest` against the checked-out tree. No sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the test asserts on probe counts and the emitted event payload, so a future change to the probe protocol will need this case updated alongside `bridge.test.ts`'s existing close cases.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full monorepo build, repo-wide lint, and the full test suite were not run. Only `packages/acp-bridge` was exercised.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

References #14389, Item 1 only. The issue tracks six items and Items 2–6 are untouched, so it must stay open — this PR does not close it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增两条 bridge 测试，把条件关闭「被批准」的那一半钉住。显式路径那条测试在一个已经协商了活跃工作、并对 `onlyIfUnheld` 的 `sessionClose` 探测返回 `{closed: true, holds: []}` 的子会话上建立会话，调用 `closeSession(id, undefined, {closeIfUnheld: true, reason: 'scheduled_task_deleted'})`，然后断言三件事：`sessionCount === 0`、只发送了一次 `closeIfUnheld` 探测、发出的 `session_closed` 事件带有 `reason: 'scheduled_task_deleted'`。

在显式路径上，原因值写死为字面量，而不是从调用方的 `closeOpts` 读回。`closeSessionImpl` 会重新发出 `closeOpts.reason ?? 'client_close'`，所以读回会让两边一起移动，即使交接被丢掉测试也仍然是绿的。

但显式路径无法见证 `closeIfChildUnheld` 里 `reason: opts.closeReason` 这次交接——`closeOpts` 的展开本身就已经带着同一个字面量。所以有第二条测试 `emits the detach reason when a detached session closes unheld`：它在没有 `closeOpts` 的情况下关闭一个已分离的会话，此时交接是原因值的唯一来源，丢掉它这条用例就会红。

没有生产代码改动。

## 为什么需要它

Issue #14389 的 Item 1 指出：#14276 引入的条件关闭对「它本来要服务的那个结果」没有任何覆盖。所有五处断言 `closeIfUnheld` 的地方，要么走的是拒绝路径，要么是把选项包和一个无条件关闭的 stub 对比，所以一次被批准、但实际上什么都没拆掉的关闭会一直保持绿色。

## 审阅者验证步骤

### 如何验证

先跑 bridge 套件确认两条新增用例都通过：

```
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridge.test.ts
```

再确认每条测试真的会失败：把 `closeIfUnheld` 分支里的 `reason: opts.closeReason` 改成 `reason: 'client_close'`，分离用例会以 `expected 'client_close' to be 'last_client_detached'` 失败；改动已在提交前还原。反过来把显式路径用例里 `sessionCount` 的断言改掉，也会在那一处失败。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 这是纯测试改动，bridge 的可观察行为没有变化。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

本地 macOS 环境，在检出目录上用 `npx vitest` 运行，未使用沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：测试断言的是探测次数和发出的事件负载，将来改探测协议时需要连同 `bridge.test.ts` 里已有的关闭用例一起更新。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有跑完整 monorepo 构建、全仓 lint 和完整测试套件，只跑了 `packages/acp-bridge`。
- 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

仅引用 #14389 的 Item 1。该 issue 登记了六条内容，Items 2–6 未处理，因此必须保持打开 —— 本 PR 不关闭它。

</details>

prs.title: test(web-shell): deflake large source file smoke test
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give the web-shell "large source file" smoke test its own 180-second ceiling. The test builds a 1.1 MB source file, which the workspace client fetches as five 256 KB chunks, decodes into one string, and renders in the virtualized Pierre preview. On a loaded shard the cumulative page setup and large-file load can consume Playwright's shared 60-second per-test budget before the Files tree is visible. The change raises only that test's ceiling; every assertion, fixture, and expected value stays the same.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol flagged this test as flaky on #14969: one of 278 E2E smoke tests failed on a loaded shard, and rerunning the job passed. The failure is budget exhaustion under host contention, not a product regression, so unrelated PRs keep paying for an environmental timeout. Giving the heaviest file fixture a larger ceiling makes the test deterministic without weakening what it verifies.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the named test repeatedly: `cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.files.spec.ts --grep "keeps large source files readable" --repeat-each=10 --workers=1`. Expect 10/10 passes. To exercise the failure mode, pin the test process to two CPUs and run six CPU burners in the background; the old 60-second ceiling fails with `Test timeout of 60000ms exceeded` while the `README.md` tree item is still pending, and the new ceiling passes. No product behavior is involved, so there is nothing user-visible to inspect.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: under two-CPU/six-burner contention the test failed with `Test timeout of 60000ms exceeded` while waiting for the `README.md` tree item, matching the patrol's loaded-shard report. After: the same contention run passes twice at ~54 seconds each. The assertions and the 1.1 MB fixture are byte-for-byte unchanged.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Playwright 1.61.1 with Chromium headless shell against the local Vite dev server (`npm run dev` in `packages/web-shell`); the daemon is mocked in the page.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A genuinely hung run can now take up to three minutes before failing instead of one; the job's 75-minute cap still bounds the shard, and only this test's ceiling changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: The exact ECS pool conditions were not available; the failure was reproduced with CPU contention on Linux. The product path is untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17366

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为 web-shell 的“大源文件”冒烟用例设置独立的 180 秒时间上限。该用例会构造一个 1.1 MB 的源文件，工作区客户端通过五个 256 KB 分块读取它，解码为单个字符串，再交给虚拟化的 Pierre 预览渲染。在负载较高的分片上，累计的页面初始化与大文件加载可能耗尽 Playwright 共享的 60 秒单用例预算，而此时文件树还没有显示出来。本次改动只提高该用例的时间上限；所有断言、夹具和期望值均保持不变。

## 为什么需要

CI Failure Patrol 在 #14969 上将这个用例标记为 flaky：负载较高的分片上 278 个 E2E 冒烟用例中有 1 个失败，而重跑该 job 后通过。该失败是主机争用下的预算耗尽，而不是产品回归，因此无关的 PR 会持续为这个环境性超时付出代价。为最重的文件夹具提供更大的上限，可以在不弱化验证内容的前提下让用例变得确定。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

反复运行指定用例：`cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.files.spec.ts --grep "keeps large source files readable" --repeat-each=10 --workers=1`。预期 10/10 通过。若要复现失败模式，将测试进程绑定到两个 CPU，并在后台运行六个 CPU 忙循环；旧的 60 秒上限会在等待 `README.md` 树节点时以 `Test timeout of 60000ms exceeded` 失败，而新上限会通过。这不涉及产品行为，因此没有用户可见的内容需要检查。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前：在两 CPU、六个忙循环的争用下，用例在等待 `README.md` 树节点时以 `Test timeout of 60000ms exceeded` 失败，与巡逻报告的负载分片情况一致。修改后：相同的争用运行两次均通过，每次约 54 秒。断言与 1.1 MB 夹具逐字节未变。

### 测试环境

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows     |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Playwright 1.61.1 与 Chromium headless shell，针对本地 Vite 开发服务器（在 `packages/web-shell` 中运行 `npm run dev`）；daemon 在页面内被模拟。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：真正挂起的运行现在最多需要三分钟才失败，而不是一分钟；job 的 75 分钟上限仍会约束分片，而且只有这个用例的上限发生变化。
- 未验证 / 范围外：无法获得 ECS 池的确切条件；失败是在 Linux 上通过 CPU 争用复现的。产品路径未改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #17366

</details>

prs.title: fix(channels): stop resending a GitHub reply after an ambiguous answer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the restart-retry pass for pending GitHub replies treat an ambiguous delivery answer as consumed, so a reply GitHub may already have posted is not sent a second time. The ambiguous audit row now records which pending record it decided, and the resend guard reads that.

## Why it's needed

At channel start, `retryPendingFinalDeliveries()` re-sends replies stored in the pending-delivery file. When GitHub answers a re-send ambiguously (a 502, a timeout — the write may have landed), the pass audits `failed_ambiguous` and then removes the record so it is never sent again.

That removal can fail — ENOSPC, EACCES, a failed rename — and the record then survives to the next start. The guard that should stop the second send, `hasPostedPublicationAudit()`, only recognised a `posted` row carrying that `pendingId`, and the `failed_ambiguous` row carried none. So on the next start the record was sent again, and a thread whose first comment had actually landed received a second public reply.

Fixes #16394.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression test drives two consecutive retry passes. The first one answers the comment call ambiguously and leaves the pending file unparseable, so the record survives; the second pass starts with that record still on disk.

Without the change, `createComment` is called twice across the two passes (the duplicate this issue reports). With the change, it is called once — the second pass finds the `failed_ambiguous` audit for that `pendingId`, drops the record, and sends nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

```
# without the fix (source reverted, new test kept):
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
 Tests  1 failed | 521 skipped (522)

# with the fix:
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  522 passed (522)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Unit tests only; macOS is the only platform I ran them on. The code path is platform-independent.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an ambiguous answer is now sticky for that pending record even if GitHub provably never created the comment. That is the same at-most-once contract the source-key guard already applies to `failed_ambiguous`, so the two idempotency paths now agree instead of disagreeing. The cost of being wrong is a reply that is never retried; the cost of the old behaviour was a duplicate public comment.
- Not validated / out of scope: I did not exercise a real failed rewrite (ENOSPC/EACCES) against a live GitHub endpoint; the test simulates it by making the pending file unparseable, the same way the neighbouring test does. The broader rework suggested in the issue — converging this pass on `readPublicationAuditKeys()` — is deliberately not part of this change: that guard resolves "last outcome per source key wins", and a later definite `failed` row re-opens a key, so moving onto it needs its own correctness argument for records retried across restarts.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing audit rows without a `pendingId` keep their current meaning.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16394

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 GitHub 待发回复的重启重发流程把「歧义」的投递答复视为已消费，从而不会把 GitHub 可能已经发出的回复再发一次。歧义审计行现在会记录它判定的是哪条待发记录，重发守卫据此读取。

## 为什么需要

channel 启动时，`retryPendingFinalDeliveries()` 会重发待发文件里保存的回复。当 GitHub 对重发给出歧义答复（502、超时——写操作可能已经成功）时，这一轮会记一条 `failed_ambiguous` 审计，随后删除该记录，保证不再重发。

但删除可能失败——ENOSPC、EACCES、rename 失败——记录于是留到了下次启动。本该拦住第二次发送的 `hasPostedPublicationAudit()` 只认携带该 `pendingId` 的 `posted` 行，而 `failed_ambiguous` 行不带 `pendingId`。于是下次启动会再次发送，第一次评论其实已经落地的线程就收到了第二条公开回复。

修复 #16394。

## 审查测试计划

### 如何验证

回归测试连续驱动两轮重发。第一轮让评论调用返回歧义、并让待发文件不可解析，记录因此存活；第二轮开始时该记录仍在磁盘上。

没有本改动时，两轮合计 `createComment` 被调用两次（即本 issue 报告的重复）。有本改动时只调用一次——第二轮发现该 `pendingId` 的 `failed_ambiguous` 审计，删除记录，不再发送。

### 证据（改动前后）

```
# 撤掉修复、保留新测试：
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
 Tests  1 failed | 521 skipped (522)

# 加上修复：
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  522 passed (522)
```

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

仅单元测试；我只在 macOS 上跑过。该代码路径与平台无关。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：对某条待发记录而言，歧义答复现在变成粘性的，即使 GitHub 确实没建出评论。这与 source-key 守卫对 `failed_ambiguous` 已采用的至多一次契约一致，因此两条幂等路径从互相矛盾变为一致。判错的代价是一条回复不再重试；旧行为的代价是多出一条公开评论。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：我没有对真实 GitHub 端点制造真实的写入失败（ENOSPC/EACCES）；测试通过把待发文件变为不可解析来模拟，与相邻测试手法相同。issue 中建议的更大幅度重构——让本轮改用 `readPublicationAuditKeys()`——有意没有包含在本改动中：该守卫按「同一 source key 最后一条 outcome 胜出」，之后一条确定性的 `failed` 会重新打开该 key，跨重启重发的记录要用它需要单独的正确性论证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有 `pendingId` 的历史审计行语义不变。

</details>

prs.title: docs(design): bring the rollout-switch design up to date with main
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Brings the rollout-switch design up to date with main, in both languages. The nightly legs that are not the shared loop's now export `'0'` instead of `''` (#17048), so the design says so and why it matters after a default flip. The tri-state paragraph is written in the past tense, since the CLI already stopped collapsing an unset setting and the headless and Ink TUI defaults have flipped. The split with #17048 records that it merged, and two file references that had moved point at the current lines.

The Chinese version also gains a space after each bold lead-in that ends with a full stop, so those lead-ins render as bold (18 of them did not), and its OpenTUI renderer line names the renderer as the English line does. With that, both versions have the same headings, tables, table rows, list items, paragraphs, code spans and bold spans.

## Why it's needed

The review of #17336 found the `''` lines and the present-tense paragraph stale after the default flip; they described main as it was before #17048 and #17362.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Read the two changed paragraphs against `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` (the `agent-loop` env lines) and `packages/cli/src/config/config.ts` (the setting is passed through unset).
- Render the Chinese version: every bold lead-in now renders as bold.

Results: Prettier clean; the English and Chinese versions have the same counts of headings (12), tables (2), table rows (13), list items (46), paragraphs (69), code spans (216) and bold spans (29).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: documentation only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ➖   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ➖   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none; documentation only.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other design docs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-12-loop-rollout-switches.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-12-loop-rollout-switches.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #17045 (block B); follows the review of #17336.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 rollout-switches 设计（中英两版）与 main 一致。不属于共享 loop 的 nightly 组现在导出 `'0'` 而不是 `''`（#17048），设计里写明这一点，以及它在默认值翻转之后为什么重要。三态那一段改为过去时，因为 CLI 早已不再把未设置的设置塌缩，headless 和 Ink TUI 的默认值也已翻转。与 #17048 的分工那一段记录它已合入，两处已经移动的文件引用指向当前的行。

#17336 的评审发现，默认值翻转之后 `''` 那两行和现在时的那一段已经过时；它们描述的是 #17048 和 #17362 之前的 main。

prs.title: fix(permissions): report malformed rules instead of dropping them silently
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A permission rule whose parentheses do not balance is parsed as inert: it matches nothing. On the current base (#15794) such a rule already produces one generic warning, but that line cannot say which list owns it — the same malformed rule in `allow` and `deny` prints two identical lines — it repeats for every manager the hosted path builds, and `/permissions` still filters the rule out, so it cannot be seen or deleted there. This PR makes the drop visible: the permission manager warns on the console, naming the list, the raw rule and the consequence, using the same operator-facing breadcrumb `tools.eager` already prints from the same initializer; and `/permissions` keeps the unparsable rule in the listing, marked `(unparsable)`, so it can be seen and deleted instead of being filtered out. Matching semantics are unchanged — a malformed rule still matches nothing, so no allow/deny decision moves.

## Why it's needed

The asymmetry is what makes this a security problem rather than a logging nit: a malformed allow rule fails closed (nothing gets auto-approved), but a malformed deny/ask rule fails open — the restriction the operator wrote does not exist, and neither startup output nor `/permissions` mentioned it. The operator's mental model is "docker is blocked"; the runtime's behaviour is "no such rule". Turning silent fail-open into visible fail-open is the minimal, semantics-preserving step the issue asks for first: the operator still has to fix the configuration, but now they know there is something to fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Write a malformed deny rule into a settings file:

```json
{ "permissions": { "deny": ["Bash(docker *"] } }
```

Start the CLI. Before any prompt, stderr shows:

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

Open `/permissions`, switch to the Deny tab: the rule is listed as `(unparsable) Bash(docker *`. Select it and delete it — the row disappears and stays gone on the next open. Then fix the rule to `Bash(docker *)` and restart: no warning, no marker, and a denied command prompts as before.

Focused suites:

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.tsx src/i18n
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: starting with `deny: ["Bash(docker *"]` printed a generic line with no list name — `[permissions] ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *` — emitted by `packages/core/src/permissions/permission-rules.ts`, once per manager the hosted path builds; and `/permissions` simply did not list the rule.

After, from the built CLI with that settings file:

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

With the corrected rule `Bash(docker *)` the same run prints no warning — the negative control.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS: Node 22.23.4, `npm run build`, all focused suites green, plus the headless run quoted above. Linux: Docker `node:22-bookworm`, same suites green, and `tsc --noEmit` clean for both packages. Windows was not run.

### Environment (optional)

Focused unit suites and a headless `dist/index.js` run with a temporary `HOME`; the Linux pass used a Docker volume workspace because a bind-mounted tree trips `rimraf` with `ENOTEMPTY`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a configuration that keeps a malformed rule now prints one line per bad rule from the permission manager at startup (the pre-existing `permission-rules.ts` line can still fire for the same configuration, so a single run may show both shapes), and `/permissions` shows an extra row. No permission decision changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the issue's other two asks — failing closed (rejecting a malformed deny/ask at load, or denying the tool it names) and the analogous `tools.disabled` typo check — are deliberately left out. The first changes runtime matching semantics, the second is a separate registry check; both fit a follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `parseRules` no longer writes to the debug log; reporting moved into the permission manager, its only caller.
- Coordination: #15775 implements the same fix for the same issue, so only one of the two can land; whoever merges second will conflict on the dialog, data and parser files.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15752 — already closed by #15794, which landed the generic warning this PR builds on. This PR is a follow-up to that fix, not a fix for that issue.

The two deferred rule shapes — `Bash(rm -rf /))` and `Bash)` — are tracked in #16078, which stays open for the maintainer decision on whether they should be rejected at load. The separate `tools.disabled` typo check was wired up in #16120 and is not part of this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

括号不配对的权限规则会被解析成惰性规则：它不匹配任何调用。在当前 base（#15794）上，这类规则已经会打一行通用告警，但那一行说不清规则属于哪张列表（同一条畸形规则同时出现在 `allow` 和 `deny` 时会打两行完全相同的日志）、会随 hosted 路径每次新建 manager 重复打印，而且 `/permissions` 仍然把它过滤掉，既看不到也删不掉。这个 PR 把"被丢弃"变成可见：权限管理器在控制台告警，点明所在的列表、原始规则和后果，写法沿用同一个初始化流程里 `tools.eager` 已经在用的"面向操作者"面包屑；同时 `/permissions` 不再过滤掉无法解析的规则，而是把它列出来并标注 `(unparsable)`，让操作者能看到并删除。匹配语义完全没有变——畸形规则依旧不匹配任何东西，所以没有任何 allow/deny 判定会因此改变。

## 为什么需要它

这种不对称正是它属于安全问题而不只是日志问题的原因：畸形 allow 规则是 fail-closed（不会自动放行任何东西），但畸形 deny/ask 规则是 fail-open——操作者写下的限制并不存在，而且启动输出和 `/permissions` 都不会提到它。操作者的心智模型是"docker 被拦住了"，运行时的事实是"根本没有这条规则"。把静默的 fail-open 变成可见的 fail-open，是这个 issue 要求的第一步，也是改动最小、不触碰语义的一步：配置仍然要由操作者自己修，但现在他知道有东西要修。

## Reviewer Test Plan（评审验证计划）

### 如何验证

把一条畸形 deny 规则写进配置文件：

```json
{ "permissions": { "deny": ["Bash(docker *"] } }
```

启动 CLI。在任何提示词之前，stderr 会打印：

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

打开 `/permissions`，切到 Deny 标签页：该规则显示为 `(unparsable) Bash(docker *`。选中它并删除，这一行会消失，下次打开也不再出现。再把规则改成 `Bash(docker *)` 重启：没有告警、没有标记，被拒绝的命令照旧弹确认。

定向测试：

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.tsx src/i18n
```

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：用 `deny: ["Bash(docker *"]` 启动只打印一行不带列表名的通用告警 `[permissions] ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *`（来自 `packages/core/src/permissions/permission-rules.ts`，hosted 路径每新建一个 manager 就重复一次），`/permissions` 也完全不列出这条规则。

改动后，用该配置文件运行构建产物：

```
permissions.deny: ignoring malformed deny rule (no closing parenthesis at the end): "Bash(docker *". The rule has no effect; write it as "Tool(specifier)", with the "(" and ")" around the whole specifier.
```

把规则改成 `Bash(docker *)` 后同样运行不再打印任何告警——反向对照。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

macOS：Node 22.23.4，`npm run build`，上述定向测试全部通过，并做了上文引用的 headless 运行。Linux：Docker `node:22-bookworm`，同样的测试全部通过，两个包的 `tsc --noEmit` 也干净。Windows 未运行。

### 运行环境（可选）

定向单元测试，加上用临时 `HOME` 跑的 `dist/index.js` headless 运行；Linux 那轮用 Docker volume 作工作区，因为 bind mount 的目录会让 `rimraf` 报 `ENOTEMPTY`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：如果配置里保留了畸形规则，启动时权限管理器会按每条坏规则打印一行（原有的 `permission-rules.ts` 那行仍可能对同一份配置触发，所以一次运行可能同时看到两种文案），`/permissions` 也会多出一行。没有任何权限判定发生变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：issue 提出的另外两项——fail-closed（加载时拒绝畸形 deny/ask，或直接拒绝它点名的工具）以及 `tools.disabled` 拼写错误的同类校验——有意未包含。前者会改变运行时匹配语义，后者是另一条注册表校验路径，都更适合作为后续 PR。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。`parseRules` 不再写 debug 日志，告警移到了权限管理器里，而它是唯一的调用方。
- 协作：同样修复这个 issue 的 #15775 仍然开着，两者只能落一个；后合的那个会在对话框、数据与 parser 文件上冲突。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15752——该 issue 已由 #15794 关闭，后者落了本 PR 在其基础上继续的通用告警；本 PR 是那次修复的后续，而不是修复 #15752 本身。

被推迟的两种规则形态——`Bash(rm -rf /))` 和 `Bash)`——记录在 #16078，该 issue 仍开着，等待维护者决定是否在加载时直接拒绝。另一项 `tools.disabled` 拼写校验已由 #16120 接上，不属于本 PR。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

</details>
